Head of Talent Acquisition - 80-100K package + BSPCE

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer calls, schedule and reschedule appointments for healthcare providers, so their teams can focus on care. We are 50 today.

We've just raised a $20M Series A led by Norrsken, with the founders of Alan and Datadog, and we're opening the US from New York. In 2027, we'll hire 60 to 80 people across France and the US. How well we execute these hires will directly decide whether we hit our business goals.

Talent Acquisition is the last function we haven't built in-house. Today it runs on freelancers, and every transition means starting over: new onboarding, relationship to rebuild, company story to re-explain. We're now hiring the person who will build and own this function for the long run, as a member of the COMEX.

Your mission

Build the team and the system that let Vocca hire 60 to 80 people a year at the pace and quality level the business needs, across several countries. You set the recruiting strategy with the founders, you build and lead the TA team, and you personally own the hardest hires.

Expected outcomes

  • Improve our recruiting model, based on quality over quantity: with the founders, you've sharpened how Vocca hires (who owns what between TA and hiring managers, where we raise the bar, where we cut steps) and turned it into a hiring plan mapped to business needs, by team and by country. Every hire meets the bar, even when volume goes up.

  • A TA team built from scratch: from today's freelance setup to a team of 4 to 6 recruiters by end of 2027, in France and the US, with the right mix of permanent recruiters and freelancers for speed, quality and cost.

  • 60 to 80 hires delivered in 2027 at the expected quality bar.

  • A scalable recruiting system: playbook, scorecards, referrals system, tooling and dashboards live, with tracked KPIs (time-to-hire, offer acceptance, probation validation, quality of hire).

  • AI across the funnel: a recruiting AI strategy you designed and own, with a measurable gain in team productivity.

  • Critical roles closed: senior and critical hires closed by you at first.

  • Autonomous hiring managers: HMs trained on the key recruiting skills, and high satisfaction among HMs and leadership.

  • Employer brand and budget: employer brand live in France and the US, team budget respected.

What you'll own

Strategy and planning

  • Refine the recruiting operating model with the founders

  • Translate the business plan into a hiring plan and a team budget, then own both

Build and lead the TA team

  • Hire your own team (5 to 6 recruiters by end of 2027) across countries, and set the freelance vs permanent mix

  • Train your recruiters until they're autonomous, structure the team, and manage the development of your direct reports

  • Build the playbook, methods, and tooling that make the team scale

AI in recruiting

  • Define and own Vocca's AI strategy for recruiting, from sourcing to closing

  • Test, keep what works, drop what doesn't

Own the hardest hires

  • Recruit senior and critical roles yourself, especially in the US, and know when to delegate and when to own the desk

  • Help hiring managers formalize their needs (scorecards)

  • Build direct sourcing channels that don't always rely on headhunters

  • Run processes end to end

Beyond hiring

  • Train and advise hiring managers on the key recruiting skills

  • Build Vocca's employer brand in France and the US

  • Work with the People team on topics connected to recruiting: key people, onboarding/offboarding, probation validation etc

This role is for you if

Prerequisites:

  • 6+ years in recruiting, including building and leading a TA team in a scaling tech company: you've managed recruiters, set up a playbook and tooling, and managed direct reports.

  • You've deployed AI tools in a real recruiting workflow, and your opinions come from what worked and what failed.

  • Fluent in French and English, based in Paris.

What we'll assess:

  • Business acumen: you understand how a company works, you know the tech market, and you tie hiring to revenue and budget.

  • Data-driven: you diagnose funnel problems with data and make both strategic and operational decisions from it.

  • Ownership: you move without being asked, stay engaged when things get hard, welcome feedback and see things through.

  • Leadership: you know how to sell the company and yourself. Senior candidates see you as Vocca's first showcase, and your team follows you.

  • Multi-country hiring: you can run recruiting across several countries at once, with different markets, comp standards and candidate expectations, even when you're not based there.

Nice to have:

  • A US hiring track record.

  • Experience outside TA: ops, sales, consulting, or building a company.

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want to step away from the desk once your team is in place. Here, you stay close to the hardest hires.

  • You see TA as a support function that executes requests, not a COMEX seat that shapes business and hiring decisions with the founders.

  • AI in recruiting is something you've read about more than used.

Compensation

  • OTE between €80K-100K

  • Equity (BSPCE)

Perks and benefits

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8-12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays)

  • 4 days a week in our offices in Paris

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib)

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Screening call with our Hector, Head of Talent Part-time (visio, 30-45min)

  2. Hiring manager interview with Maxime, Chief of staff (visio, 45min)

  3. Business case with Hector and Maxime (on site, 1h30)

  4. COMEX fit with Eliott (CEO), Hugo (CTO), Julie (Head of Ops), Charles (Head of Product) and Max (on site, 30 min for each duo)

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.description:
Senior Konstruktionsingenieur (w/m/x) (80-100%)

Werde Teil unseres Design Engineering Teams als hoch erfahrener Individual Contributor. Du löst anspruchsvolle mechanische Konstruktionsaufgaben selbst, von Konzepten und CAD-Modellen über Fertigungszeichnungen und Prototypen bis zu getesteter Hardware, und unterstützt gleichzeitig das erweiterte Team bei fundierten technischen Entscheidungen.

Als Senior Konstruktionsingenieur (w/m/x) bist du ein Hands-on-Mitglied unseres Design Engineering Teams und konstruierst die CO2 Collectors von Climeworks, das Herzstück unserer Direct-Air-Capture-Anlage. Wie leistungsfähig diese Collectors sind, wie sie gefertigt werden und wie sie sich skalieren lassen, ist entscheidend für den künftigen Erfolg von DAC.

  • Mechanisches Konzept- & Produktdesign: Du verwandelst neue Konzepte eigenständig in robuste physische Produkte: Du entwickelst mechanische Konzepte, erstellst CAD-Modelle, konstruierst Komponenten und komplette Kollektorbaugruppen, erstellst Fertigungszeichnungen und begleitest die Hardware durch Fertigung, Montage und Tests.

  • Technische Problemlösung & Risikoreduktion: Deine Erfahrung hilft dir, schneller die richtigen Lösungen zu finden, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen und Risiken zu reduzieren, bevor sie sich in der Fertigung oder bei Tests auswirken.

  • CO₂-Kollektordesign: Du entwickelst mechanische Systeme von den Anforderungen und ersten Konzepten bis hin zu detaillierten, fertigungsgerechten Konstruktionen. Du erarbeitest Lösungen, führst technische Berechnungen durch und triffst die notwendigen Entscheidungen, um robuste industrielle Hardware zu entwickeln.

  • Engineering nach grundlegenden Prinzipien: Du nutzt deine Erfahrung und dein Denken nach grundlegenden technischen Prinzipien, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen, Alternativen schnell zu bewerten und einfache, robuste Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du setzt Berechnungen, Toleranzanalysen, Design Reviews und Tests ein, um Unsicherheiten zu reduzieren.

  • Design vom Konzept bis zur Kommerzialisierung: Du arbeitest direkt in SolidWorks, um Teile, Baugruppen und Systemlayouts zu erstellen und anzupassen. Du steuerst komplexe Schnittstellen, Bauraumbeschränkungen und Designänderungen, damit das Gesamtsystem optimal zusammenspielt. Du erstellst und pflegst hochwertige 2D-Fertigungszeichnungen, einschließlich geeigneter GD&T-Angaben, Toleranzen, Materialien, Oberflächen und Fertigungsanforderungen.

  • Prototypenfertigung, Montage & Tests: Du bleibst auch nach Abschluss der CAD-Arbeiten eng eingebunden. Du unterstützt die Fertigung, Montage und das Testen von Prototypen, untersuchst auftretende Probleme und lässt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse wieder in das Design einfließen.

  • Technische Führung & Design Reviews: Du fungierst als erfahrene technische Ansprechperson für das Team und unterstützt die Leitung des Design Engineering Teams bei Design Reviews, Engineering-Standards und der Freigabe kritischer Designs. Du unterstützt das erweiterte Team mit deinem technischen Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen mechanischen Designentscheidungen, trägst zur Einhaltung hoher Engineering-Standards bei und teilst deine Erfahrung durch die tägliche Zusammenarbeit, Mentoring und konstruktives Hinterfragen.

  • Interdisziplinäre Engineering-Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit Fertigung, Testing, Process Engineering, Procurement, Lieferanten und anderen Engineering-Disziplinen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass mechanische Designs als Teil des Gesamtprodukts funktionieren. Bei Bedarf bindest du externe Designressourcen ein.


Was dich auszeichnet

Deine Erfahrung macht deine Ingenieurarbeit wirksamer: Du erkennst vielversprechende Lösungen früh, deckst Schwachstellen auf, bevor sie teuer werden, und lieferst Konstruktionen, die klar, fertigungsgerecht und bereit für den Einsatz in der Praxis sind.

  • Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion: Du bringst 15+ Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion mit, idealerweise in der Entwicklung komplexer Industrieanlagen von der Konzeption über Fertigung und Montage bis zum Test.

  • Blechkonstruktion und Fertigung: Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Blechteilen, Strukturen und Baugruppen für die Fertigung in grossen Stückzahlen. Du kennst Biegen, Schweiss- und Fügeverfahren, Umformen, Toleranzen sowie die Wahl von Material und Blechdicke und weisst, wie sich Konstruktionsentscheide auf Werkzeuge, Kosten, Montage und Qualität auswirken.

  • CAD und Zeichnungen: Du bist SolidWorks-Expertin bzw. -Experte und arbeitest weiterhin selbst im CAD. Du erstellst hochwertige Fertigungszeichnungen persönlich und bist sicher im Umgang mit GD&T und Toleranzketten.

  • System Design und technisches Urteilsvermögen: Du hast Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Komponenten und Mechanismen über Subsysteme und Schnittstellen bis hin zu komplexen Baugruppen. Du verstehst, wie sich Entscheidungen auf einer Ebene auf den gesamten Collector auswirken, und wägst Strukturen, Luftführung, Bewegung, Abdichtung, Prozessschnittstellen, Fertigbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosten ab, um zu robusten Lösungen zu kommen.

  • Fertigung und DFMA: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse über zerspanend gefertigte Teile, Schweisskonstruktionen, Werkstoffe und Fertigungsverfahren und wendest DFMA an, um robuste und kostengünstige Konstruktionen zu entwickeln.

  • Zusammenarbeit und Technical Leadership: Du arbeitest gut mit Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieuren, Technikerinnen und Technikern, Fertigungspartnern und Lieferanten zusammen. Du teilst deine Erfahrung, hinterfragst konstruktiv und hilfst anderen, bessere technische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Ausbildung: Du hast einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Maschinenbau oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst fliessend Englisch. Dies ist ein Muss-Kriterum, da unsere Unternehmenssprache Englisch ist.

Diese Stelle ist nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du hauptsächlich Personen oder Projekte führen möchtest.

  • du hauptsächlich Simulation, Konzeptarbeit oder System Engineering ohne eigene CAD-Arbeit betreibst.

  • du keine Erfahrung mit Blech, Schweisskonstruktionen oder Fertigung in grossen Stückzahlen hast.

jobs.description:
AI Automation Intern, Communications

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases

1. Media monitoring platform

  • Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

  • Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

  • Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

  • Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam

  • Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

  • Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

  • Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

  • Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking

  • Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

  • Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

  • Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

  • Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

  • By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring

  • A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

  • A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

  • Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

  • Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

  • Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.


Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

jobs.title: Account Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
Account Manager, Americas

Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

As we continue to support growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic, results-driven Account Manager to join our team, focusing on the higher education, K-12 and enterprise industries.

Position Summary:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

In this role, you will do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. As an Account Manager, you are the primary architect of our existing client relationships. You will lead the full renewal lifecycle and identify strategic expansion opportunities, ensuring our partners realize the maximum value of the Panopto platform. This role requires a proactive, sales-oriented mindset and the ability to turn complex technical needs into simple, elegant solutions for our customers.You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Software Renewals: Manage the software renewal process for assigned accounts, ensuring timely and successful contract renewals. Proactively engage with clients to discuss their current usage, address any concerns, and present upgrade options to ensure customer satisfaction and retention. Negotiate renewal terms, pricing, and contractual agreements in collaboration with the legal and finance departments.

  • Upselling and Cross-Selling: Achieve assigned quarterly and annual sales targets by proactively identifying opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional software licenses, modules, or services to existing clients. Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value and benefits of recommended software enhancements. Collaborate closely with the sales and marketing teams to develop targeted strategies and campaigns to maximize upselling potential.

  • Account Planning and Forecasting: Develop account plans and strategies to achieve upselling and renewal objectives. Monitor account usage and health, revenue performance, and customer satisfaction metrics regularly. Provide accurate sales forecasts and pipeline updates to management, leveraging CRM tools and reporting systems.

  • Market Research and Competitive Analysis: Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive landscape within the corporations, higher education and K-12 sectors. Conduct market research and analysis to identify new business opportunities and potential target accounts. Collaborate with the marketing team to provide insights and contribute to the development of effective sales and marketing materials.

  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders in enterprise, higher education and K-12 institutions. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, addressing customer inquiries, and providing excellent customer service. Understand clients' business needs, objectives, and challenges to identify upselling opportunities and position relevant software solutions.

How We Thrive:

You’ll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people, knowing our success depends on our collective wisdom. Reporting to the Director of Account Management, you will work in lockstep with our Customer Support and Implementation teams to ensure a seamless experience for every partner. We believe in simple elegance and hold ourselves accountable to meaningful outcomes, not just activity, meaning you are empowered to focus on the strategic work that truly moves the needle for our customers.

The Foundation for Success:

  • Relationship Mastery: You have 5 years of experience in sales or account management (ideally in SaaS), with a proven track record of exceeding quotas through authentic relationship building.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You can take a complex software solution and articulate its value in a way that feels simple and essential to a client’s success.

  • Operational Ownership: You are proficient with CRM tools and sales productivity stacks, using them to create clarity for yourself and the leadership team.

  • Outcome-Oriented: You are self-motivated and thrive when given the independence to manage your territory and own your results.

  • Adaptability: You are comfortable traveling up to 25% to meet our partners where they are and represent Panopto at industry events.

  • Educational Baseline: A Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field provides the foundation, but your commitment to lifelong learning is what will make you successful here.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Within 6 Months (Integration and audit): You have fully mastered the Panopto ecosystem and completed a comprehensive health audit of your assigned Americas territory. You have established seamless collaborative loops with the Support and Implementation teams, identifying "at-risk" accounts early and implementing "save" strategies that ensure no customer is left behind.

  • Within 1 Year (First measurable impact on Net Revenue Retention): You have delivered a 100% on-time renewal rate for your portfolio and successfully executed your first major expansion deals. By shifting from a reactive renewal cycle to a proactive value-based partnership, you have measurably increased the Net Revenue Retention (NRR) within your territory, proving that our customers are not just staying, but growing with us.

  • Your Legacy (Full ownership of the Americas Strategic Growth Playbook): You are recognized as the definitive subject matter expert for the Americas market. You have designed and documented a repeatable "Success Playbook" for navigating complex renewals and identifying expansion opportunities that the global Account Management team adopts as a standard. Your impact is felt not just in the revenue you’ve secured, but in the elevated craft and collective wisdom you’ve shared with the entire organization.

Join Panopto and be part of an exciting journey where you’ll have the chance to make a real impact on the company's success and growth. If you excel in communication with a vigorous sales orientation mindset, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation

Total Rewards:

The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $80,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for commission earnings per the Sales Commissions Plan with an on-target-earnings of $125,000 USD as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Additional Information

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs

About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs, you run program management between our GTM organization and Product & Engineering. 

You are the connection point between both sides. You bring them together early on upcoming changes, align on what those changes mean for customers & partners, and determine what support customers need and which internal teams have to be prepared. From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.

Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.

This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.

Areas of ownership:

  • GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.

  • Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.

  • Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.

  • Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.

  • Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.

Who you are:

  • 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program

  • You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions

  • Technically fluent in enterprise software platforms: you can assess what a change means for customers without Engineering explaining it each time

  • You operate without formal authority — you've held teams to deadlines you don't own, and you're comfortable making the call

  • You build the system, not just the tracker; you've created or fixed a process that outlived your tenure

  • Energized rather than paralyzed by ambiguity; you build the playbook while running the plays

  • An exceptionally strong writer, equally at home in technical detail and executive narrative

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

The ideal candidate approaches enterprise business development and intelligence in an analytical manner, is data-driven, and is a creative problem-solver

 

What you will do:

About You:

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise shifting workloads and responsibilities effectively.

  • Eager to understand and navigate long sales cycles.

  • Commercially minded and possesses a deep understanding of issues large accounts are facing.

  • Fluent in English (other languages are a plus)

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

jobs.title: Field Sales Account Executive
jobs.description:
Field Sales Account Executive

Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must 

  • Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

  • Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

  • General technical proficiency with software

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Director, Industry Practice Lead - Corporate Enterprise
jobs.description:
Director, Industry Practice Lead - Corporate Enterprise

Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead – Corporate Enterprise, you will serve as Panopto’s trusted domain authority and top-of-funnel growth engine across the enterprise market. Operating as a senior individual contributor reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will bridge corporate talent strategy, workforce enablement, and product capability. You will serve as a sought-after expert in L&D and corporate learning, building peer-level trust with Chief Learning Officers, Heads of Talent, and enterprise IT leaders to open new pipeline and articulate how video-based knowledge management transforms workforce productivity.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Top-of-Funnel Pipeline Creation & Industry Authority: Represent Panopto as a leading voice at major industry conferences (e.g., ATD, DevLearn, HR Tech), executive roundtables, and panel discussions. Activate your executive network to generate trusted top-of-funnel prospects, raise brand awareness, and open new enterprise pipeline.

  • Strategic Subject Matter Expertise in Deals: Partner with Account Executives on high-profile pre-sales opportunities as an industry peer and product expert. Seamlessly discuss corporate learning trends, business objectives, and Jobs to Be Done (JTBD) to build buyer confidence without carrying direct deal-closing responsibility.

  • Customer Value & Adoption Advisory: Conduct strategic account engagements with existing enterprise customers to evaluate current usage patterns, understand business goals, and prescribe tailored solution strategies that improve adoption, increase platform value, and identify natural expansion opportunities.

  • Domain Frameworks & Product Voice: Develop practitioner-focused domain playbooks, usage frameworks, and industry point-of-view content that elevate field conversations. Synthesize field signals on corporate learning challenges, compliance needs, and AI workflows to advise internal Product and Product Marketing teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a baseline assessment of corporate enterprise buyer priorities, establish an engagement cadence with Sales and Product Marketing, and participate in select high-profile pre-sales strategy discussions.

  • Within 6 Months: Publish initial industry point-of-view content, lead executive engagements at key industry events to build top-of-funnel pipeline, and deliver solution adoption recommendations for top enterprise accounts.

  • Within 1 Year: Drive measurable growth in influenced pipeline, brand presence, and account expansion across Fortune 500 accounts, establishing Panopto as the premier partner for corporate video learning.

  • Your Legacy: Build a scalable, repeatable vertical practice model that elevates Panopto's market authority and defines domain-led growth.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

At Panopto, we believe in simple elegance in everything we do. We do not just talk about accountability; we live it. You will be joining a collaborative team of seasoned Account Executives and Revenue leaders who are deeply embedded in the enterprise sector.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead, you will be the bridge between technical capability and business transformation. You will partner directly with our Account Executives to inspire leaders, demonstrate the value of our platform, and bring our AI-driven video knowledge vision to life. This is an opportunity to serve as a trusted advisor to key buyers, shape our go-to-market strategy, and serve as the voice of the customer back to our Product and Engineering teams.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Instructional Design, Organizational Development, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 8+ years of total experience combining corporate domain leadership (e.g., L&D, Enablement, Talent Development) with 3+ years of commercial GTM experience (e.g., Solutions Consulting, Practice Strategy, Value Engineering) in enterprise SaaS.

  • Technical & Product Proficiency: Strong understanding of enterprise learning technology stacks (LMS, LXP, HRIS), video infrastructure, and integration concepts (SSO, API workflows). Ability to demonstrate platform capabilities through an industry and user-outcome lens.

  • Communication & Influence: Proven track record as a conference speaker, executive communicator, or published writer skilled at engaging C-suite executives, HR leaders, and IT buyers.

  • Domain Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of corporate learning metrics, workforce upskilling frameworks, knowledge management challenges, and enterprise procurement dynamics.

  • Travel Commitment: Willingness to travel 25% – 40% for customer engagements, industry conferences, and key field events.

What Sets You Apart

  • Master’s degree or professional certifications (e.g., CPTD, CPTM).

  • Active advisory or leadership roles in major HR and L&D communities (e.g., ATD, Brandon Hall, Bersin, HR Tech).

  • Direct experience leading enterprise learning transformations or adopting AI-driven learning tools at scale.

Join Us

Join Panopto and play a pivotal role in transforming how enterprise organizations capture, share, and scale workforce knowledge. If you are a seasoned L&D and technology leader ready to drive executive engagement and accelerate growth across Fortune 500 accounts, we encourage you to apply.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for a bonus as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Compensation

Additional Information

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (Upper South Island, NZ)
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager (Upper South Island, NZ)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role.

We’re growing our team in the South Island, to meet market demand! Halter is looking for a hungry and driven sales leader to work with our sales team and grow Halter in the Upper South Island dairy team. We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into customers. A ‘never give up attitude’ is crucial for this role; you will be a significant contributor to the growth and success of Halter in the Upper SI.

You’ll be responsible for setting and managing quotas and commissions for the team, sales capability management and mentoring for our junior sales staff. You’ll use your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers’ farm systems. You'll detail Halter’s value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the Upper South Island region ideally in Christchurch. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

What your day could look like.

  • Setting and managing quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks for the sales team.

  • Coaching, mentoring and developing our junior sales staff to help drive their professional growth to reach targets.

  • Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.

  • Meet high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.

  • Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.

  • Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.

  • Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.

  • Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.

  • Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales

Who are we looking for.

  • A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.

  • Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.

  • Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.

  • Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.

  • Experience in dairy farming or within the agricultural sector is a highly preferred.

  • A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.

  • Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet.

  • Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred

  • A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives.
