jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer - Real-Time Voice

About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About The Role:

Voice is one of the most demanding and differentiated parts of what we do. As Principal Software Engineer for Voice/VoIP, you'll own the technical direction of our real-time voice infrastructure — the systems that let AI agents have natural, low-latency phone conversations at enterprise scale, across telephony providers, carriers, and global markets.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set architectural direction, solve the hardest problems yourself, and raise the bar for how the wider engineering org builds and reasons about voice systems. You'll work closely with infrastructure, AI/ML, and product teams to ensure our voice stack is fast, reliable, and ready to scale globally.

Areas Of Ownership:

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Parloa's Voice/VoIP infrastructure, including SIP trunking, media handling, and real-time audio pipelines

  • Design for low-latency, high-availability voice at enterprise scale — across global telephony carriers and providers

  • Drive technical decisions on protocols and standards (SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, WebRTC, ICE, STUN/TURN) and real-time media transport

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to optimise the integration between voice infrastructure and conversational AI models (ASR, TTS, turn-taking, barge-in)

  • Diagnose and resolve deep, systemic issues in call quality, latency, jitter, and packet loss across distributed, multi-region deployments

  • Define and uphold engineering standards for reliability, observability, and security across the voice stack

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, acting as a technical multiplier across the organisation

  • Evaluate and integrate with telephony providers, carriers, and SIP trunk vendors as Parloa expands into new markets

  • Represent Parloa's technical voice expertise in conversations with enterprise customers and partners where needed

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on building, operating, or debugging production Voice/VoIP, SIP, WebRTC, or carrier-grade voice infrastructure

  • Strong knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, WebRTC, ICE, and real-time media transport protocols

  • Hands-on understanding of audio codecs and media behavior, including Opus, G.711/G.722, codec negotiation/transcoding, DTMF/RFC2833, jitter buffers, packetization, and codec-related quality/latency trade-offs

  • Experience building or operating large-scale, distributed, real-time systems with strict latency and availability requirements

  • A track record of owning architecture for complex systems and driving technical decisions with broad organisational impact

  • Experience working with telephony carriers, SIP trunk providers, or PSTN integrations at scale

  • Deep, hands-on ownership of production SIP-based voice infrastructure at enterprise scale (e.g. Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, pjsip)

  • Strong systems programming skills in one or more of Go, C, C++ or Rust, with the ability to work at the media/transport layer.

  • Comfort operating in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and with container orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex technical trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike

  • A genuine interest in AI and conversational technology, and how voice infrastructure underpins it

  • Experience instrumenting and operating voice-quality observability — call-quality metrics (e.g. MOS), per-leg call tracing, and diagnosing jitter, latency, and packet loss from telemetry

Our Engineering Values:

At Parloa, we hire, promote, and evaluate based on cultural and technical excellence. You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Earn Trust – act with transparency and reliability.

  • Obsess Over Customers – always start with the customer problem.

  • Think Big – set bold goals and pursue them fearlessly.

  • Have Integrity – do the right thing, especially when it’s hard.

  • Disagree & Commit – debate with candor, align fast, and deliver.

  • Own It – take full responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Dive Deep – master the details without losing sight of the big picture.

  • Bias for Action – move fast, decide quickly, iterate fearlessly.

  • Deliver Value – measure success by customer and business impact.

  • Insist on the Highest Standards – raise the bar continuously.

  • Go the Extra Mile – make the impossible possible.

  • Hire & Elevate the Best – raise the bar with every hire

Our Recruiting Process:

Recruiter Interview → Technical Peer Interview → 360° Tech Interview Loop → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

jobs.description:
Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst

With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Advanced Cybercrime and Engagements Team, Insikt Group, Recorded Future

Location: Remote USA (Preference for Boston, MA or Washington, DC)

The Role: You will research and analyze criminal activity on dark web/underground platforms, such as forums, shops, marketplaces, and secure communication channels, to identify cybercrime trends and threat actors. You will also help identify sources, maintain persistence on those sources, and interact with threat actors to obtain information not publicly available. You will be engaged in proactive research, with the flexibility to respond to requests from Recorded Future colleagues and customers related to cybercriminal activities. You will use open-source intelligence (OSINT), internal tools such as the Recorded Future Intelligence Operations Platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) to inform customers and internal stakeholders about the latest cybercriminal threat activities and trends, ensuring timely, actionable insights.

Who You'll Work With: The Advanced Cybercrime and Engagement team is a group of subject matter experts specializing in identifying, tracking, and mitigating cybercriminal threat actors and their activities. The team supports a variety of Recorded Future products, teams, services, and initiatives for both internal stakeholders and customers. You will also cross-collaborate with other Insikt Group teams on research projects and some customer requests.

What You'll Do:

  • Research, track, and author finished intelligence reports on cybercriminal threat actors, malicious tools and services, source types, Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), campaigns, and other cybercriminal-related topics.
  • Identify, propose, and publish proactive Analyst Notes and reports on new and emerging threats, cybercriminal activities, and campaigns, specifically on dark web threat actors, money laundering operations, hacktivists, and threat groups associated with different types of cybercriminality for customer and public consumption.
  • Drive sourcing, collecting, and curating new data into the Recorded Future Intelligence Cloud, using AI-assisted triage to cut through volume faster than manual review.
  • Create and maintain access to underground sources and personas to achieve net-new intelligence.
  • Contribute ideas for new automations or AI-assisted workflows to improve the speed and consistency of the team's production process, and share lessons learned/best practices broadly.

What You'll Bring (Required Qualifications):

  • Fluency or professional proficiency in Russian
  • Strong knowledge and experience with analytic tradecraft, the intelligence cycle, open-source intelligence gathering techniques, and strong intelligence writing skills, techniques, and methodologies.
  • Be able to document and cogently explain to customers research findings. Be comfortable and confident in presenting research findings to customers and at conferences.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in roles in cyber intelligence, cybersecurity more broadly, cyber and cybercriminal investigations, or other related disciplines.
  • Advanced knowledge of operational security (OPSEC) procedure and practices.
  • Demonstrated experience operating on dark web sources (forums, marketplaces, and shops) and mediums of communication.
  • Experience in engaging with cybercriminals and participating in covert operations in handling sensitive information.
  • Knowledge of the structure and trends within the cybercriminal economy and landscape in different/specific regions: common communications vectors, source locations, operational security considerations, and more.
  • Experience with handling, transacting in, and tracing cryptocurrencies.
  • Knowledge of and ability to conduct blockchain and cryptocurrency investigations.
  • Knowledge of money laundering, fraud, and current cybercrime TTPs.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with others in a globally distributed environment.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your own research and writing, and the instinct to reach for them to speed up or automate a task.
  • Ability to write clear, specific AI prompts and iterate as needed, and to fact-check and edit AI output for validity and objectivity.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BA/BS or MA/MS degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, International Relations, Security Studies, Regional Studies, Criminology, or a related discipline.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the cybercriminal ecosystem.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the links and relationships between cybercriminal, hacktivist, extremist, and state-sponsored operations and organizations.
  • Technical knowledge of malware trends, including ransomware, its functionality and capabilities, and how it’s impacting entities.
  • Practical experience integrating or leveraging LLMs (for example, GPT, Claude, Gemini) in real-world applications, tools, or workflows to develop efficiencies in intelligence analysis.

Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.

The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.

On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.

Think AWS-like granularity, but built to empower enterprises with speed, flexibility, and resilience.

About The Role

A Senior Engineering Manager at Parloa does the same job as an Engineering Manager, at a bigger and harder scope. You own delivery and business outcomes for a large team, for two or more teams, or for a domain whose work spans several teams. Sometimes the scope is defined by size; sometimes it is defined by difficulty, such as a problem area where the technical and organisational complexity is genuinely hard, and where getting it right matters to the company's roadmap.

What changes at this level is altitude and durability. You communicate credibly to Directors and VPs without your manager in the room, framing recommendations and trade-offs rather than reporting status. You own the narrative for cross-functional work that travels beyond your teams. You take the conversations that Engineering Managers escalate to you - performance edge cases, prioritisation conflicts between teams, hard disagreements with peers - and you resolve them. And you are building the next layer of leaders: the tech leads who will become EMs, the senior engineers who will become Staff.

You are not primarily a manager of managers. Some Senior EMs move that way, on the path to Director, but most do not and this role does not require it. The people work gets harder at this level, not lighter.

Areas Of Ownership

  • Own delivery across a multi-team or multi-domain scope. Set milestones, critical path, and quality gates. Manage cross-team dependencies actively rather than reporting on them. Hold a consistent bar for Definition of Done and quality across the scope.

  • Set strategy and roadmap with Product, not unilaterally. Frame engineering investment in commercial terms - revenue, retention, margin - and surface customer and market signals into the plan.

  • Own the narrative for cross-functional initiatives. Stakeholders walk away aligned, not merely informed. Author durable artefacts - plans, RFCs, escalation memos, postmortems — that still stand up months later and travel beyond the people in the room.

  • Create the conditions for coherent technical direction. Partner with Staff+ ICs to shape the technical agenda and own tech debt strategy across your scope. Champion experimentation and prune low-signal bets early. Codify and share the learnings from failures.

  • Hold operational discipline to a consistent standard. On-call, incident response, and postmortem practice across your scope; reliability targets aligned to product expectations; cost and unit-economics trends tracked and corrected before they spike. Treat blockers as priority work and clear them hands-on across team boundaries.

  • Design the operating model for your scope. Roles, ownership, and on-call rotations; multi-team operating rhythm; aggregated DORA and SLO metrics; 3–6 month dependency mapping and capacity rebalancing.

  • Grow the next layer of leaders. Hire senior ICs up to Staff level and, where applicable, first-line team leads. Build a pipeline for hard-to-fill roles. Identify and develop future managers and senior ICs from within. Drive calibration across your scope and coach peer managers on promotion standards.

  • Eliminate classes of blockers, not just individual ones. When something breaks twice, you fix the system that lets it break.

Who You Are

  • A proven engineering leader, typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4-6+ years of people leadership. You have owned outcomes for more than one team or for a domain spanning several teams.

  • Credible with senior leadership. You can walk into a room with a VP or a CPO and frame a trade-off, not just present a status update. Your written work is concise and decision-driving.

  • A builder of leaders. You can point to specific people you hired, grew, and promoted(e.g. a tech lead who became an EM, a senior engineer who became Staff) and describe what you actually did.

  • Technically credible without needing to be the decision-maker. You partner with Staff and Principal engineers to shape technical direction through influence, and you know when to hold a standard versus when to let a team choose.

  • Commercially fluent. You understand what your scope costs, what it returns, and how to have that conversation with Product and Finance.

  • Comfortable with the hard conversations. Performance edge cases, prioritisation conflict between teams, and disagreements with peers are part of the job, and you take them on early rather than letting them fester.

  • Pragmatic under real pressure. You have recovered a stalled cross-team initiative, or taken on a scope that had lost predictability, without burning out the engineers or making the EMs feel stepped on.

  • An Engineering Manager with a bigger title. The scope or impact has to be real.

  • A step on the way to managing managers. Some Senior EMs go that way; most do not. This is a complete job on its own terms.

  • Distance from your team. If you are looking for a role where the people work gets lighter, this is not it.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As the Workplace Technology Lead you'll be the domain expert and technical authority for workplace technology and AV innovation within Corporate Engineering. Setting technical direction, leading technology delivery for capital builds, and creating and owning repeatable standards that support employees, clinicians and members.

This is a senior technical leadership role, so you'll deliver by influencing, coordinating and partnering across the organisation (Engineering, Facilities, Clinical, Real Estate). It combines hands-on delivery, programme leadership and practical AI solutions, and you'll shape how the function grows as Neko expands.

Your scope covers collaboration and meeting spaces, employee experience, executive briefing centres, clinic environmental AV and debrief-room presentation, digital signage, and technology integration across a growing portfolio of health centres. Network, security, facilities, clinical systems and scanning hardware stay with their specialist owners, and you'll work closely with them.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Map the estate, opening pipeline, suppliers, ownership and risks in your first 60 days, and agree the role charter, roadmap and budget baseline with Technology and Operations

  • Create a global technology roadmap aligned to expansion plans, workplace needs and the member experience, turned into investment priorities, delivery plans and lifecycle budgets

  • Act as design authority for workplace and AV: define reference designs, preferred solutions and a clear process for local variations

  • Review existing standards, take full ownership of them in Corporate Engineering, and create a repeatable technology build playbook, piloted on an agreed site or room type

  • Lead the technology workstream for new offices, health centres and refurbishments, from feasibility and design through procurement, commissioning and operational handover

  • Own the integrated technology programme: financial forecasts, risks, changes and executive reporting, with clear readiness criteria, acceptance tests and defect tracking for each opening

  • Work with clinical operations and design teams on debrief displays, ambient audio, signage and controls, prioritising simple use, discretion and a calm environment for members

  • Test two approved operational AI use cases, for example automated commissioning tools, through measured pilots

  • Establish asset and lifecycle records, supplier reviews and service requirements with Procurement and support owners

  • Deliver a costed proposal and an 18–24 month plan for the next stage of the function, with any hiring linked to the site pipeline and support demand

What We're Looking For

  • Substantial experience in workplace technology, enterprise AV and integrated systems, including delivery across multiple countries and physical environments

  • A record of technical leadership: setting standards across a complex portfolio and developing others through influence rather than line authority

  • Experience taking technology projects through architectural design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, with commercial and programme accountability

  • Ability to explain technical decisions to executives, clinicians, designers and delivery partners, and to connect investment choices to practical user needs

  • Practical curiosity about AI and automation, with the judgement to test outputs and involve specialist owners

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-environment experience

  • Enterprise and experiential delivery experience

Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Neko Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute
jobs.description:
Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture.

In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale.

This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

First Customer’s Point of Contact

  • Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries.

  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution.

  • Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently.

  • Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable.

 
 

Technical Support

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for:

    • GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures).

    • Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations).

    • Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters).

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems.

  • Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems

  • Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

 
 

Kubernetes & Containerization

  • Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on:

    • Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity).

  • Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors.

  • Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling.

 
 

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting).

  • Contribute to post-mortems with actionable follow-ups to prevent recurring incidents.

  • Train internal teams on best practices for compute infrastructure and debugging.

  • Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support team.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, technical support, or infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on compute-heavy environments (bare metal, cloud, HPC, or virtualization).

  • Deep Linux/Unix expertise:

    • Debugging kernel-level issues (e.g., OOM killer, I/O bottlenecks, CPU throttling).

    • Performance tuning (e.g., sysctl, ulimit, filesystem optimizations).

    • Networking troubleshooting (e.g., iptables, tcpdump, DNS, NFS, SSH).

    • Storage management (e.g., LVM, RAID, NVMe, GPU-local storage).

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience is mandatory:

    • Debugging pods, nodes, and clusters (e.g., kubectl describe, kubectl logs, crictl).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes).

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, containerd) and basic IaC awareness Proficiency with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

  • Basic scripting/automation skills (preferably Go, but Bash or Python are acceptable for ad-hoc tasks).

  • Experience with bare metal, virtualization, or HPC environments (e.g., Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast) is a strong plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for resolving issues efficiently and improving system reliability.

  • Ability to work in on-call rotations and handle high-pressure situations with a structured, calm approach.

  • Commitment to meeting tight SLAs for issue acknowledgment, triage, and first response.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Customer Care Associate
jobs.description:
Customer Care Associate

Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As Customer Care Associate, you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer issues from first contact through resolution across French and Spanish-speaking markets

  • Build and deliver fast, reliable support workflows used by distributors in day-to-day operations

  • Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly

  • Make decisions that directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and order flow continuity

  • Improve support quality by identifying patterns in recurring issues and driving root-cause fixes

  • Take responsibility for clear escalation and coordination with internal teams when needed

  • Coaching and training of external agents supporting Choco customers

  • Collaborate with external support agents and internal teams to maintain high-quality service standards

What you bring

  • 1+ years of experience in customer support or operations in fast-paced, tech-enabled environments, with a track record of owning outcomes

  • Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations

  • Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving

  • Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully

  • Native level of French speaking & writing is required

  • Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken)

Working hours

This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Directeur ou directrice de projets Grands Comptes (H/F)

NOTRE AGENCE

Periscope est une agence de marketing et de communication digitale indépendante qui accompagne notamment des associations, des ONG et des acteurs de l'intérêt général.

Nos clients se répartissent en trois familles :

  • Générosité : faire donner (ONG, fondations, associations)

  • Communauté : faire adhérer

  • Impact : faire recourir à un service

Notre organisation repose sur des pôles d'expertise, chacun avec son chef de projet dédié :

  • Social : stratégie et animation des réseaux sociaux

  • Design : identité, UX/UI, création

  • Développement : sites, landing pages, intégrations

  • Marketing : SEA, SEO et data

Cette organisation garantit un haut niveau d'expertise sur chaque métier.

Le poste de Directeur / Directrice de projets Grands Comptes a pour vocation de relier ces différentes expertises et d'assurer leur cohérence sur les accompagnements transverses mobilisant plusieurs pôles.

LE POSTE

Passionné(e) par la culture digitale et convaincu(e) du rôle essentiel des associations et ONG dans notre société, vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de projets qui ont du sens ?

Rattaché(e) au pôle Commerce, vous assurez le pilotage opérationnel global de quelques grands comptes stratégiques multi expertises, principalement des ONG et des associations, dont les accompagnements mobilisent plusieurs pôles d'expertise de l'agence.

Véritable chef d'orchestre de ces comptes, vous en êtes le référent opérationnel en interne. Vous en maîtrisez les enjeux, l'historique et les priorités, et veillez à assurer une coordination fluide entre les différentes expertises, avec une vision partagée des objectifs et des engagements clients.

Vous exercez une autorité fonctionnelle sur les chefs de projet métiers dans le cadre des projets transverses, notamment pour coordonner les interventions, arbitrer les priorités et garantir la cohérence globale des accompagnements, sans lien hiérarchique direct.

VOS MISSIONS

1. Piloter les grands comptes et coordonner les expertises

  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel privilégié des clients au quotidien et assurer le suivi global de leurs accompagnements multi expertises

jobs.description:
Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

The Role

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

  • Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.

  • Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.

  • Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.

  • Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.

  • Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.

  • Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness.

  • Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements.

  • Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities.

  • Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications.

  • Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges.

  • Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture.

What we offer

  • Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments.

  • Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards.

  • Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems.

  • Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

  • Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

  • Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

  • Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

  • Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

Technical Support Manager (m/f/d) L2

🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Keep 2,000+ care facilities running

When voize works, nurses get 39 minutes of their shift back. When something breaks, a firewall silently blocking sync, an interface mismatch with a facility's care software or a regression after a release; documentation stops and care teams feel it immediately. Your mission: make sure that downtime is minimum, and never happens twice.

As Technical Support Manager, you own our technically hardest customer cases end-to-end. You work at the intersection of our AI product, real-world facility IT, and the German care software ecosystem - with a direct line to our Engineering team, not a ticket queue between you. And your work has leverage: one root cause you find and fix can resolve an issue for dozens or hundreds of facilities at once.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Own escalated cases from 1st-level support end-to-end: reproduce, isolate the fault across app, backend, customer network, and third-party systems and keep the customer clearly informed until it's solved

  • Debug integrations with leading German care documentation systems: interface errors, data and schema mismatches, and on-prem configurations in customer environments (Windows/Linux)

  • Untangle customer-side IT - firewalls, proxies, certificates, MDM-managed shared devices - often in direct coordination with a facility's IT

  • Take the lead in critical incidents: assess which facilities are affected, drive resolution together with Engineering, and own clear, timely communication to customers and internal stakeholders

  • Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes: root-cause analyses with Product & Engineering, input into pre-release QA, runbooks and knowledge-base articles - and mentor 1st-level colleagues along the way as you help shape our escalation playbooks

🤝 Your Skillset — What you bring to the table

  • Hands-on experience with observability/monitoring tools (Grafana, Sentry) and strong networking fundamentals (firewalls, proxies, DNS, TLS/certificates) - you can use logs, metrics, and traces to figure out why systems can't talk to each other

  • Solid Windows and/or Linux system administration in enterprise or customer environments - you're at home in logs, configs, and the command line

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations - you can read a payload and trace where data breaks between systems

  • Experience owning 2nd/3rd-level escalations in complex environments

  • German proficiency at C2 / billingual level - our customers work with us in German, so this is a hard requirement

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior/Staff Product Designer

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.

Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.

  • Drive executive decision-making through concise written narratives, data and clear recommendations, replacing fragmented status reporting with a trusted source of truth.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics that enable objective decisions around scope, schedule, quality and execution risk.

  • Build lightweight mechanisms that improve planning, dependency management and execution across teams, leaving the organization stronger after the program completes.

  • Influence technical and organizational decisions without direct authority, aligning engineering, product and business stakeholders around shared outcomes.

  • 7+ years of Technical Program Management experience, or equivalent experience leading large-scale technical programs with software engineering teams.

  • Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs from definition through launch across organizations you did not directly manage.

  • Experience leading release readiness for production systems, including defining objective launch criteria and driving launch decisions.

  • Strong track record of identifying delivery risk early, driving mitigation plans and making effective escalation decisions.

  • Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies and engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience defining program metrics and using data to guide execution and executive decision-making.

  • Exceptional written communication skills. You can distill a complex technical situation into a clear one-page narrative for senior leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience delivering AI, machine learning or LLM-powered products at scale, ideally in a high-growth engineering organization.

  • Experience building program management mechanisms that became durable organizational practices.

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

jobs.description:
Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

Spécialiste Support Services Financiers (Télétravail complet possible)

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Senior Design Manager

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are our product principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Role context

 

  • The Financial Services track is looking for a Senior Product Design Manager to lead its design team as the current design leader transitions into a broader product leadership role.

     

  • This role will be central to raising experience quality across Financial Services, maintaining coherence with the wider SME product, and designing high-converting experiences that contribute to Pennylane’s acquisition and revenue goals.

 

Main responsibilities

  • Lead, support, and develop a team of four Product Designers and one first-time Design Manager, all reporting directly to you.

  • Coach the Design Manager in building strong management practices, developing team members, and creating the conditions for high performance.

  • Set a clear design direction for Financial Services, translating product and business priorities into an actionable experience strategy.

  • Raise the quality and consistency of customer experiences across the Financial Services journey while ensuring coherence with the broader SME product.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other stakeholders to design experiences that support acquisition, activation, conversion, and revenue objectives.

    Guide designers through complex product challenges, strengthening craft, strategic thinking, customer understanding, and measurable impact.

    Represent Financial Services in cross-functional Brand and Design System initiatives, contributing to shared standards while ensuring that the track’s specific needs are addressed.

 
 

Profile we’re looking for

 

You have significant experience leading Product Design teams in complex, fast-moving product environments.

You are comfortable managing both individual contributors and design managers, including coaching someone through their first management role.

You can define a compelling design direction and connect customer experience decisions with product strategy and business outcomes.

You have a strong track record of improving the quality, usability, and coherence of end-to-end digital experiences.

You understand how design contributes to acquisition, activation, conversion, and revenue, and you use qualitative and quantitative insights to guide decisions.
