jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers (Télétravail complet possible depuis Marseille)
jobs.description:
Spécialiste Support Services Financiers (Télétravail complet possible depuis Marseille)

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 
 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 
 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu portes la voix et l’usage du client et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

- Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 
 

Profil recherché

 

- Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

- Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

- Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

- À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

- Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Johan Chrzanosvski - Head of Customer Care, et Maxime Leclercq - Head of Financial Services (45 min)

 
 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

jobs.description:
Stage PFE Ingénieur Géotechnique F/H

Vous cherchez à découvrir un métier apprenant qui fait sens ? A bénéficier d'un encadrement technique fort ? Rejoignez le Groupe Fondasol en tant qu'Ingénieur Stagiaire et entrez dans une dimension favorisant la synergie de ses métiers et mobilisant données du sous-sol et révolution digitale.

Votre rôle ?

En collaboration avec les Ingénieurs et votre tuteur :

  • Vous participez à l'accompagnement de nos clients sur l’ensemble de leurs problématiques liées à la donnée du sous-sol, quels que soient le type de projet ou la mission géotechnique, ou en synergie avec les ingénieries du Groupe.

  • Du terrain aux logiciels, vous découvrez la chaine d’essais, mobilisez les datas disponibles et les méthodes et outils de calculs les plus avancés pour optimiser le modèle du sous-sol, les préconisations techniques et les solutions de travaux associées.

Quelles seront plus précisément vos missions ?

Vous vous verrez confier des missions variées avec la prise en main progressive d'affaires : organisation du chantier d'investigations, suivi des forages et échange avec les équipes de forage, exploitation et synthèse des données géotechniques.

Sous la supervision de votre tuteur :

  • Vous participez aux appels d'offres, à la construction des propositions techniques et financières.

  • Vous aidez à identifier les moyens à engager, les datas disponibles, les domaines d’expertise à solliciter pour apporter une réponse la plus globale et optimisée possible à votre client.

  • Une fois les datas nécessaires à disposition, vous contribuez à la définition des modélisations géotechniques, des hypothèses et des paramètres de calculs nécessaires au dimensionnement des ouvrages géotechniques et rédigez les rapports géotechniques.

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. jobs.title: Developer Marketing Manager, Blocks Network
jobs.description:
Developer Marketing Manager, Blocks Network

About Blocks.ai

Blocks.ai is a new initiative being built by PubNub, a global technology company with more than 15 years of experience powering real-time applications and digital experiences.

The Blocks team operates with the pace, ownership and experimentation of an early-stage product while benefiting from PubNub's proven global infrastructure, engineering expertise and established company foundation. This role is part of PubNub and will be dedicated to building developer awareness, adoption and community for Blocks Network.

Blocks.ai is the secure network for the Internet of Agents. We solve what happens after someone builds an AI agent: helping them make it reachable, discoverable, useful and commercially viable without taking on a new infrastructure project.

An agent stays wherever its developer chooses to run it and connects to Blocks Network through a single outbound connection—no inbound ports, static IP, DNS or firewall configuration required. Blocks.ai handles the routing, discovery, presence, streaming, security and economics between agents and the people, applications and other agents that need them.

Our open-source Python and TypeScript SDKs are built on PubNub's proven global real-time infrastructure, combining the speed and accessibility of a developer-first platform with technology trusted in production for more than 15 years.

About the Role

Blocks Network is looking for a Developer Marketing Manager to help developers discover, understand, try and adopt our platform, with an initial focus on builders creating AI applications and agents.

You'll own developer marketing across awareness, acquisition, activation, engagement and advocacy, turning technical product capabilities into useful, credible stories and experiences that meet developers where they learn, build and share.

Working closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and a dedicated Developer Relations (DevRel) partner, you'll create and distribute technical content, campaigns, demos and developer programmes while continuously improving the journey from first discovery to first successful build.

Success means attracting the right developers, earning their trust, helping them become successful with Blocks Network and measurably growing an active developer ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute developer marketing programmes that drive awareness, qualified developer acquisition, activation and ongoing engagement for Blocks Network.
  • Develop clear positioning and messaging for AI application and agent developers, translating APIs, SDKs and technical capabilities into relevant developer outcomes without losing accuracy or credibility.
  • Build an authentic presence in the developer communities and ecosystems where our audience learns, builds and collaborates.
  • Listen to developers, participate in technical conversations and turn community and product feedback into actionable marketing and developer-experience insights.
  • Partner with Developer Relations to create and distribute tutorials, technical demos, sample projects, integration examples, launch content, workshops and other developer resources.
  • Independently prototype lightweight demos, examples, landing-page experiences or technical marketing assets when useful.
  • Plan and distribute campaigns and content across developer channels such as documentation, GitHub, newsletters, social platforms, community forums, events, partnerships and relevant third-party ecosystems.
  • Improve the developer journey from discovery through first successful build by using qualitative feedback, product data and funnel analytics to identify friction and test ways to increase activation.
  • Define and report on meaningful developer-growth metrics including qualified acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and advocacy.
  • Use analytics, experimentation and developer feedback to continuously prioritise and improve programmes.

About You

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience in developer marketing, technical marketing, Developer Relations, developer advocacy, technical product marketing, developer growth, or another role combining technical products with external developer engagement.
  • Strong technical fluency: you can understand APIs, SDKs, code examples and modern software-development workflows well enough to communicate accurately and participate credibly in developer conversations.
  • Experience creating technical content or developer resources such as tutorials, demos, documentation, sample applications, integration guides or workshops.
  • Evidence of helping developers move beyond awareness toward evaluation, hands-on product use, activation or adoption.
  • Experience using data, analytics, experimentation or developer feedback to understand performance and improve developer journeys or programmes.
  • A community-minded, collaborative approach and comfort working across Product, Growth, Engineering and Developer Relations.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience marketing APIs, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, open-source technology or developer platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI application development, AI agents, LLM tooling or adjacent developer ecosystems.
  • Experience building or growing developer communities through GitHub, Discord, Reddit, Stack Overflow, developer events, open-source ecosystems or similar channels.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools to prototype simple demos, sample applications, landing-page experiences or other technical marketing assets.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, TypeScript or another modern programming language.
  • Experience measuring and improving developer acquisition, activation, engagement or retention funnels.

Why Join Blocks.ai

Blocks.ai is creating the connective layer for an emerging Internet of Agents, and this role will help shape how its first developer communities discover, understand and use it.

You'll have room to test ideas, work directly with the people building the product and see the impact of your work in what developers build and share across the network. You'll help establish the developer marketing motion from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature playbook.

Because Blocks.ai is being built by PubNub, you'll combine the pace, ownership and experimentation of a new venture with the backing of proven global infrastructure and an experienced technology team.

As a remote-first company, we value flexibility, collaboration and continuous learning. You'll work closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and Developer Relations while having the freedom to experiment with new ways of reaching and activating developers.

We offer a B2B engagement with monthly compensation ranging from PLN 12,000 to PLN 18,000, along with benefits that support your success and well-being, where applicable.

Principal Product Builder, Data

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Why this role exists

The cost of going from idea to working prototype has collapsed. One person with taste, strong judgment, and AI tools can now do what used to take a team and a sprint cycle. Apollo is hiring for what comes next: Product Builders who combine product judgment, domain depth, and AI-native research and execution.

This role owns Apollo Data, the data layer that is committed to providing the world’s most accurate B2B company, contact, and signal data to power a customer’s GTM stack.

Apollo is expanding from “help me find and message prospects” to “help me run my GTM motion.” That only works if Apollo upholds its commitment to offering the broadest, most accurate, and relevant B2B dataset to power GTM at scale.

This is a broad, data-centric role that spans data health and telemetry, data source acquisition, evaluation, and integration, measurement of data accuracy and quality, and a keen understanding of how data structure and taxonomy ties to the customer experience. Data is the backbone that makes Apollo the most trusted GTM execution platform in the world.

What you will own

  • The product vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Apollo’s core data catalog
  • Apollo's data as the foundation for the rest of the product: the agent, API, and workflow surfaces that are only as good as the catalog underneath them
  • Roadmap prioritization with Data Engineering, Research, and Design, keeping data initiatives tied to company OKRs
  • Apollo’s central data telemetry: the metrics and dashboards that define catalog breadth, depth, accuracy, and freshness, built with Data Science and used to drive sourcing and roadmap decisions
  • Our always-on data sourcing operation, including source identification from telemetry, evaluation, and integration
  • The bridge between R&D and Partnerships on vendor data sourcing, evaluation, and ongoing relationships
  • Collaborate with our Engineering team on the latest approaches to upleveling our core data catalog, bringing a product lens and GTM visibility into our data innovations
  • Support for key customer data initiatives and evaluations, including direct customer interaction in-tandem with our sales & field teams for all things data
  • Cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Support, and Enablement
  • The ongoing evolution of Apollo into the most trusted data layer for sales and marketing

What you will do

  • Get close to customers, GTM teams, Support, and internal users to understand where Apollo’s data has gaps and accuracy or usability issues
  • Set product strategy for an always-on motion for upleveling our native data catalog with new data sources
  • Set product strategy for how Apollo’s data shows up across the product and in customer systems: enrichment, search and filters, scoring, and the taxonomy and data structure that make the catalog usable at every surface
  • Prototype quickly using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Figma AI, and other AI-native workflows to validate ideas before scaling investment
  • Turn complex data pipelines into simple, trustworthy customer experiences across coverage, accuracy, freshness, confidence scoring, enrichment waterfalls, and data provenance
  • Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions for data sources, evaluating vendors on coverage, accuracy, freshness, cost, and compliance, and owning the business case for each
  • Partner closely with:
    • Engineering on architecture, reliability, observability, APIs, data models, and edge cases while staying anchored in customer and business outcomes
    • Design to make data trust visible: where a record came from, how fresh and confident it is, and what a customer can do when it is wrong
    • GTM, Support, and Customer Success to optimize head-to-head data quality evaluations and learn from customer data experiences
  • Define the KPI tree and learning loop for the product area, then use it to prioritize, measure, and iterate
  • Raise the bar for product clarity by writing crisp strategy docs, PRDs, launch plans, and tradeoff memos that make the next best action obvious

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex data-centric product areas from strategy through launch
  • AI-native builder. You use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Figma AI, or similar to prototype, validate, and accelerate execution. You can point to things you built or shipped, not just specs you wrote
  • Principal-level ownership across a meaningful product area with company-level visibility
  • Strong product judgment. You know how to find the highest-leverage problems, make hard tradeoffs, and protect focus
  • Data thinker. You can navigate the complexity of many data sources and aggregation processes that centralize data into a high-availability, performant data catalog product; you design and leverage clear data-backed telemetry for driving product decisions
  • Compliance fluent. You understand data privacy, GDPR and CCPA, consent, and licensing constraints well enough to design within them and partner effectively with Legal and Privacy
  • High agency. You create clarity in ambiguous environments and move work forward without waiting for perfect structure
  • Technical fluency across architecture, reliability, observability, APIs, data models, instrumentation, and edge cases
  • Customer empathy for how data gaps, stale records, and inaccuracies erode trust for sales, marketing, RevOps, admins, and end users
  • Execution excellence. You define, ship, measure, and iterate without thrash
  • Strong influence and communication. You align teams, build trust quickly, and make complex systems feel simple

Nice to have

  • Experience with B2B data products, data marketplaces, enrichment, identity resolution, or data-as-a-service businesses
  • Familiarity with entity resolution, record matching, data freshness and decay, confidence scoring, high-scale data collection and verification
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and negotiating third-party data vendor relationships, including waterfall or multi-vendor architectures
  • Experience building for sales, marketing, RevOps, customer success, or GTM operators
  • Experience using analytics, experimentation, observability, or support data to improve data quality and customer outcomes

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales
jobs.description:
Vice President of Sales

Location: Remote with Business travel.

Note: Candidates in metro areas such as Atlanta GA, Chicago IL, Dallas TX, and Los Angeles CA are highly preferred.

In addition to your base salary, you'll be eligible for a competitive commission plan designed to reward strong performance and successful new-business development.

Position Summary

SPS is seeking an accomplished Vice President of Sales to drive net-new revenue growth across its Technology Business Solutions portfolio. This executive will identify, develop and close complex, multi-year outsourcing and technology-enabled services opportunities with financial institutions, insurance companies and other highly regulated enterprises.

The successful candidate will be a proven new-logo hunter with 10 to 15 years of experience selling business process outsourcing, document management, claims processing, financial transaction processing or related managed services. Candidates must demonstrate direct responsibility for originating and closing strategic opportunities with total contract values exceeding $10 million.

The Vice President of Sales must be highly conversant in the trends shaping client buying decisions, including artificial intelligence, intelligent document processing, straight-through processing, workflow automation, data analytics and digitally enabled operating models. The executive must be able to create opportunities where none currently exist, build senior client relationships and lead multidisciplinary teams through complex enterprise sales cycles.

Reporting Relationship

The Vice President of Sales will report directly to the Head of TBS Sales and work closely with TBS business leadership, solution design, operations, technology, finance, legal, risk and executive management.

This is a senior individual-contributor role accountable for originating and closing new business. It is not primarily an account-management or sales-team administration position.

Key Responsibilities

New Logo Business Development

  • Develop and execute a targeted business-development strategy focused primarily on acquiring new enterprise clients.
  • Identify high-potential prospects across banking, financial services, insurance and other industries where relevant.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of complex opportunities with individual total contract values generally exceeding $10 million.
  • Create opportunities through executive networking, industry relationships, market intelligence, referrals and focused account-based outreach.
  • Establish relationships with C-suite executives and senior leaders across operations, technology, finance, procurement, claims, payments, customer experience and transformation.
  • Maintain accountability for pipeline creation, opportunity progression, bookings and revenue conversion.

Complex Solution Sales

  • Lead the complete sales lifecycle from market identification and initial client engagement through discovery, solution development, proposal, negotiation and contract execution.
  • Diagnose client operating challenges and translate them into compelling outsourcing, transformation and managed-services solutions.
  • Develop solutions spanning business process outsourcing; document intake, digitization and records management; claims processing; payments, remittance and lockbox processing; customer communications; intelligent document processing; back-office operations; and technology-enabled managed services.
  • Position SPS around measurable client outcomes, including lower operating costs, improved service quality, faster processing, stronger controls, compliance and operational resilience.
  • Build persuasive financial cases demonstrating productivity improvement, risk reduction, return on investment and transformation value.
  • Lead negotiations involving pricing, service levels, transformation investments, risk allocation and multi-year contractual terms.

Technology and Market Leadership

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies and operating-model changes influencing sourcing and transformation decisions.
  • Demonstrate fluency in artificial intelligence and generative AI, intelligent document processing, straight-through processing, robotic and intelligent process automation, workflow orchestration, predictive analytics, cloud-enabled processing and digital customer communications.
  • Explain how AI and automation can improve cycle time, accuracy, productivity, customer experience and operating cost while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.
  • Understand the practical application of straight-through processing across claims, payments, remittance, document intake and other high-volume transaction environments.
  • Engage credibly with client operations, technology, risk, security and compliance executives about the adoption of emerging technologies.
  • Stay current on data privacy, cybersecurity, regulation and operational-resilience requirements affecting financial services and insurance clients.

Pursuit Leadership

  • Serve as the leader for major pursuits and coordinate solution design, operations, technology, finance, legal, risk and executive sponsors.
  • Develop opportunity-specific win strategies, competitive positioning and executive engagement plans.
  • Facilitate client discovery sessions, solution workshops, presentations, site visits and executive negotiations.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are operationally achievable, competitively differentiated and financially attractive.
  • Apply disciplined opportunity qualification and recommend when SPS should invest in, reshape or discontinue a pursuit.
  • Provide accurate forecasts, pipeline reporting, probability assessments and deal-closing plans.

Market Development

  • Monitor competitor capabilities, market positioning, pricing models and major outsourcing transactions.
  • Identify client needs and new service offerings that can expand the SPS addressable market.
  • Represent SPS at relevant industry conferences, executive forums and client events.
  • Build productive relationships with advisors, consultants, sourcing firms and other market influencers.
  • Provide market feedback to help shape the TBS solution portfolio, investment priorities and go-to-market strategy.

Required Experience

  • 10 to 15 years of enterprise sales and business-development experience in BPO, BPS, managed services, document management, transaction processing or technology-enabled business services.
  • Demonstrated success identifying and winning net-new enterprise clients.
  • Personal involvement in originating, shaping and closing multiple complex opportunities with total contract values exceeding $10 million.
  • Experience selling multi-year solutions into financial services, insurance or similarly complex industries.
  • Strong understanding of at least two relevant domains: banking and financial transaction processing; insurance claims; document and records management; payments, remittance or lockbox; customer communications; back-office outsourcing; or intelligent document processing and workflow automation.
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles that may extend from 12 to 24 months.
  • Ability to sell business outcomes and transformation value rather than stand-alone products, software or staff augmentation.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams through solution development, pricing, contracting and implementation planning.
  • Established relationships with senior executives in relevant target markets.
  • Strong understanding of governance, risk, compliance and security requirements in regulated client environments.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience selling solutions that combine people, process, technology, automation and onshore, nearshore or offshore delivery.
  • Background with a leading global BPO, BPS, technology services, document-services or financial transaction-processing company.
  • Experience with competitive RFPs, sole-source negotiations, rebids, renewals and client-led sourcing processes.
  • Knowledge of outcome-based, transaction-based, gain-share and other managed services pricing structures.

Physical Demands:

  • Fine and/or gross motor skills, including the ability to grasp, lift and/or carry objects.
  • Ability to walk, bend, kneel, stand, and/or sit for an extended period of time.
  • Able to speak, hear and communicate in person and virtually.
  • Able to work on/off site.
  • Must be able to handle rejection, conflict and work under deadlines/business demands.
  • Able to work on/off site and travel based on business needs.
  • Able to work multiple time zones if needed.
  • Manual dexterity required for operating office machinery (computer, printer, fax machines, copiers and other essential business equipment needed to complete job duties)
  • Physically able to talk on the phone and input data simultaneously on a computer.
  • Ability to lift or move objects as needed.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, ability to adjust focus and ability to match or may include detection of differences between colors, including shades of color and brightness.

Travel: Some travel is required for this position. Approximately up to 25%.

Other Duties:

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation:
The expected compensation is an estimate, and the final offer will depend on skills, experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Vacancy Status:
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Range

$160,000—$190,000 USD

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.
  • Paid Time Off: Full time: Minimum of 80 hours/calendar year. Part time/temporary: Minimum of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked. PTO amounts may increase based on tenure and/or the assigned account. PTO allows employees to take approved time off for any reason.

Across North America, we help clients enhance workplace experiences and business operations through services including workplace support, physical and digital mailroom solutions, intelligent document processing, reception and concierge services, and other business support offerings.

  • AOI-Programme neu erstellen, optimieren und bei Änderungen an Baugruppen nachführen
  • AOI-Prüfungen selbstständig durchführen und SMT-bestückte Leiterplatten unter dem Mikroskop kontrollieren

nu:legal baut eine KI-Plattform, die Unternehmen rechtliche, regulatorische und bürokratische Prozesse von A bis Z abnimmt. Wir sind ein kleines, ehrgeiziges Team in Berlin. Schick uns einen Link zu deinem Portfolio, deinen Case Studies oder deinen Figma-Dateien. Echte Arbeit und ein klarer Designprozess überzeugen uns mehr als Politur. Wir antworten auf jede ernst gemeinte Bewerbung innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)

Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

Technology and a great e-commerce experience lie at the heart of our business. Thousands of restaurants order their supplies through Choco every day. You will own a core part of that experience, from how buyers find products to how they place their orders. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with a practical approach, strong analytical skills and commercial acumen. You understand what makes digital buying experiences work and turn buyer needs and enterprise customer requirements into scalable product improvements that make ordering easier and drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a core area of the e-commerce experience across journeys such as product discovery, search, cart, checkout and ordering, shaping its roadmap and driving measurable improvements for buyers and the business.

  • Lead a squad of engineers and a designer from discovery to delivery, shipping valuable features at a high pace and quality.

  • Talk directly with buyers and enterprise customers to understand their needs, test product ideas, and turn insights into improvements to the buying experience.

  • Make data-driven decisions that measurably improve the e-commerce experience and drive business impact, assessing the value of features before and after launch with a focus on conversion rate, average order value, purchase frequency and retention.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win and grow enterprise accounts, from large distributors to manufacturers. Turn customer-specific needs into scalable product capabilities, balancing commercial opportunities with value for the broader customer base.

  • Use AI in your daily work and find opportunities to apply it in the buyer experience.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including work with enterprise customers.

  • Experience building and optimizing customer-facing e-commerce journeys such as product discovery, search, catalog, cart, checkout and ordering.

  • A track record of leading a product area end to end, from discovery to delivery, in a scale-up and measurably improving its business results.

  • Sharp product sense and prioritization: you can dive deep into detail while keeping the bigger picture in view.

  • Strong ownership and flexibility: you thrive in a fast-changing environment, are comfortable with ambiguity, and take full responsibility for results.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence, aligning leadership, commercial teams and engineering behind clear decisions.

  • Solid business, technical and UX understanding, and a clear view of how product decisions translate into commercial performance.

  • A user-centric and data-driven approach, combining regular customer contact with strong analytical skills and the ability to work with data yourself.

  • Experience using AI to scale your own work.

  • Excellent communication skills: you move easily from technical discussions with engineers to explaining our product vision in a way anyone understands.

  • Nice to have: experience in the food industry, wholesale or distribution.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Marketing Manager (m/f/d) - Berlin

Join Voyfai, a fast-growing Series A startup shaping the future of logistics and technology across Europe.

Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the centre of a broader group of companies active across several European markets.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with our Co-Founders from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping how we run the company, leading strategic initiatives or building new organisational rhythms from scratch, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

As our Marketing Manager (m/f/d), you will drive our social media reach to grow our membership. You will attract European and US freight forwarders who join our network and route their Asia–Europe volumes through our procurement hub in Hong Kong, with LinkedIn and WeChat as your key channels, supported by trade press outreach. You are a hands-on executor: you turn goals into content, campaigns and pitches that get results, and you bring ideas of your own. You will report to our Director of Global Network and work closely with our commercial, product and procurement teams. This role is based in Berlin.

What You Will Do

  • Own our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn and expanding to WeChat, including content, campaigns and the profiles of our leadership and network team

  • Create content built for reach, and adapt it to how each platform's algorithm works

  • Run campaigns and pitch our story to freight and logistics trade media to bring qualified freight forwarders to the commercial team

  • Write presentations, sales pitches and member material together with the commercial and product teams

  • Work with our Hong Kong procurement team to showcase the strength of our offering

  • Prepare the marketing material for trade fairs and industry events, such as decks, one-pagers and social posts

  • Brief and coordinate freelancers or other support where needed

  • Track reach, engagement and member growth, and report on results

What You Bring

  • 5 years of B2B marketing experience with a focus on social media, ideally in freight, logistics, B2B services, SaaS, membership or network businesses

  • A proven track record of growing reach and engagement on LinkedIn, organic and paid

  • Experience in freight, logistics or a similar industry, or a track record of marketing to logistics professionals, ideally including freight forwarder networks or membership organisations

  • A clear understanding of how social media algorithms work and what drives reach

  • Fluent English with excellent writing and presentation skills, including sales pitches, decks and media pitches

  • Comfort working with AI tools in your daily work

  • A hands-on, self-driven mindset: you take ownership, define what "done" looks like and move work forward without close guidance

  • Mandarin or Cantonese

  • A dynamic, fast-paced work environment with a mission-driven team

  • Regular team events and offsites

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)

Your Impact

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity.

What you'll do

Senior Partner Sales Manager

Location: London, in the office 3–4 days a week, with travel across Europe and North America
Regions: UK & Ireland, Nordics, DACH, Benelux, North America
Reports to: Partner GTM Lead

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

Partners are central to how Light grows. Accounting firms, advisory practices and implementation partners bring us into deals, deliver alongside us and help finance teams move off legacy ERPs.

As Senior Partner Sales Manager, you’ll own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across a portfolio of strategic partners in five regions. You’ll recruit the right partners, build plans with them and turn those relationships into qualified pipeline and closed deals, working hand in hand with our account executives. You’ll work closely with Sales, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, Marketing and Legal.

This is a senior seat in building Light’s partner programme. You’ll own a revenue target, and you’ll help shape how partnerships work here for years to come.

  • First 90 days: Each priority partner has an agreed joint business plan, the first partner-sourced opportunities are in pipeline, and you’ve signed a new partner.

  • First 12 months: You’ve hit your partner-sourced bookings target, priority partners are delivering a steady flow of qualified opportunities, and partner teams are certified.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Around 7 years in B2B SaaS sales or partnerships, with real time carrying a partner or channel number

  • Existing relationships with accounting, advisory or ERP implementation firms in at least one of our regions

Location: London, with regular time in Benelux

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)

McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

Account Executive - Mid-market - €60–80K + BSPCE

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

  • Make your first prospecting calls, demos, and initial sales conversations

  • Close your first simple deals independently.

3 months:

  • Build a stable pipeline, with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages

  • Improve our call scripts and email sequences

  • Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments

  • Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

  • Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months:

  • Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

  • Contribute to structuring our sales playbook

  • Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline

  • Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

  • Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

  • Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle

  • Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers

  • Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

  • Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature)

Make the engine better

  • Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

  • Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the liberal segment

  • Deal size from 15K to 30K

  • 1 month sale cycle

  • ICP : group of independent practitioners

This role is for you if

The prerequisites:

  • You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

  • You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy.

  • You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews:

  • Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

  • Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

  • Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience

  • Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

  • Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

  • Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

  • Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

  • Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

  • You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

  • You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

  1. Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

  3. Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

  4. Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.description:
Eid. anerkannte:r Psychotherapeut:in (a) - Hybrid / Region St. Gallen / Wil (40-100%)

Standort: Hybrid (Home Office mit Remote Video Therapie sowie Möglichkeit von Arbeit vor Ort)

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload

Pensum: 40-100%

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!
