jobs.title: Product Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Frontend Engineer

quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

jobs.title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
jobs.description:
Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs

Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Hengelo, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Agentic AI Senior Consultant

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Netherlands.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.
  • Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows.
  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.
  • Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.
  • Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.
  • Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations.
  • Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles.
  • Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements.
  • Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and designing APIs for agent-based applications.
  • Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management techniques.
  • Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, observability solutions, and security guardrails for enterprise LLM applications.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience deploying distributed applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and identity management practices relevant to AI systems, including OAuth 2.0, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets management, and data privacy.
  • Ability to independently lead customer engagements, make sound technical decisions, and manage complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating technical workshops and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English and either Spanish or Italian, both written and spoken.
  • Experience working with agentic AI platforms or enterprise messaging technologies is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Solace Agent Mesh or similar agentic AI platforms is a plus.
  • Proficiency in both Go and Python is an additional advantage.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, or TIBCO is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of LLM platforms and services, including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Foundry, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring, is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and regulatory requirements in industries such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector is advantageous.
  • Experience using AI-assisted and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including the ability to demonstrate and share these practices with others.
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, and enterprise integration architectures is beneficial.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified Machine Learning or Generative AI, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, are considered an advantage.
  • Previous experience creating technical workshops, reference architectures, blogs, presentations, or demonstrations focused on agentic AI is a plus.

    • Benefits:

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Shop
jobs.description:
Product Engineer, Shop

ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

As a member of our quickly growing Global Operations and Service team, you will be responsible for directly supporting our users’ travel needs. As owners of customer satisfaction, your role is to solve issues, communicate effectively, and collaborate with internal teams to remove any barriers for the traveler - all while providing a best-in-class customer experience. As the front line of our business, you will have a unique opportunity to provide regular feedback to our product, design and engineering teams as they work towards continually improving our customer facing and internal platforms. This is an exciting role where you will have a direct impact on our day to day operations, traveler experience and product development!

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist our travelers with best-in-class travel support through multiple contact channels: chat, calls and email.
  • Maintain extensive supplier, destination and system knowledge.

jobs.title: Account Executive (AU, NZ)
jobs.description:
Account Executive (AU, NZ)

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the role

We’re hiring an Account Executive to own Australia and New Zealand across our commercial and enterprise segments. You’ll sell to founders, engineering leaders, and technical buyers, and you’ll move between a two person startup in Auckland and a regulated enterprise in Sydney in the same week. We’re after someone who has done this before, enjoys the technical depth of the work, and wants to help define how Supabase sells in the region.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close, including multi threaded enterprise deals

  • Run technical discovery and tie it to business outcomes the buyer cares about

  • Work with Sales Engineers and Product on demos, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews

  • Help customers see where Supabase fits in their stack and what it replaces

  • Build and run your own ANZ territory plan, including pipeline, forecasting, and account strategy

  • Work with AWS and regional partners and resellers to open and progress deals

  • Handle data residency, security, and procurement conversations with enterprise and public sector buyers

  • Hand off to Customer Success so customers onboard well and expand

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in a technical sales role, ideally selling developer tools, databases, cloud infrastructure, or open source

  • A record of consistently beating quota, with numbers you can walk us through

  • Experience closing both fast moving commercial deals and longer enterprise cycles with procurement, security, and legal involved

  • Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with an engineer without bringing a Sales Engineer to every call

  • Comfort selling to founders, CTOs, and platform teams

  • Strong judgment about where to spend your time across a territory spanning two countries and several time zones

  • Self-directed, at ease with ambiguity, and happy to build the playbook as you go

Nice to have

  • Experience with Postgres, or a competing backend or database platform

  • An existing network across the ANZ startup, scale-up, and developer ecosystem

  • Experience with cloud marketplace or co-sell motions, particularly AWS

  • Familiarity with ANZ compliance expectations, such as Australian Privacy Act, NZ Privacy Act, or financial services and government requirements

Why Supabase

You’ll sell a product developers already love, with real inbound demand and a fast growing open source community behind it. The territory is yours, the ownership is real, and the team is small enough that your ideas get used rather than filed.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Full-Time Australia, New Zealand

Sales Recruiter

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About the Role

Apollo is hiring a Sales Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our GTM organization. This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight, self-diagnoses problems before they escalate, and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

What You Will Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across GTM Sales Hiring, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously
  • Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance, not just instinct
  • Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans, and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions
  • Manage 20+ phone screens per week and drive 360+ outbound contacts per quarter
  • Hold the bar on candidate quality, give direct and honest feedback, and avoid passing weak profiles to sidestep an uncomfortable conversation
  • Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in Greenhouse and self-report on progress to leadership without being asked
  • Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations
  • Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor: shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.
  • Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity
  • Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales or Revenue roles in SaaS
  • Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity
  • Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence, not just execute
  • Strong data fluency: you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations

Als Key Account Manager DACH (all genders) bei tonies bist du die strategische Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Produkten und den führenden Handelsunternehmen der DACH-Region. Mit Verhandlungsgeschick, strategischem Weitblick und einer großen Portion Begeisterung steuerst du unsere wichtigsten Accounts, hebst Umsatzpotenziale und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere Marktposition langfristig auszubauen.

  • Du trägst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für das operative Geschäft deiner Key Accounts und entwickelst die Kundenbeziehungen durch proaktive Betreuung kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du bereitest Jahresgespräche und unterjährige Verhandlungen gewissenhaft vor, führst sie souverän und setzt die getroffenen Vereinbarungen konsequent um. Dabei analysierst du die Ergebnisse eingehend und behältst die Wirksamkeit stets im Blick.

  • Für eine zuverlässige Erfüllung unserer Unternehmensziele planst du regelmäßig Verkaufsmengen und Umsätze für deine Kunden

  • Eine enge Abstimmung und effektive Zusammenarbeit mit allen relevanten internen Schnittstellen sind für dich selbstverständlich

  • Du bist ca. 20% deiner Zeit on the road, d.h. besuchst regelmäßig die Kundenzentralen und nimmst aktiv an branchenspezifischen Messen teil

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du bringst eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit und hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung als nationaler Key Account Manager*in mit direktem Kundenkontakt.

  • Jahresgespräche und unterjährige Preisverhandlungen hast du aktiv mitgestaltet und entwickelst deine Verhandlungsstärke kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Analytisches Denken liegt dir im Blut: Du gehst sicher mit Daten um und triffst damit fundierte Entscheidungen. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Tools und Systeme ein (z. B. Google-Produkte, Tableau, Slack) und vermittelst auch technische Zusammenhänge verständlich.

  • Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Dafür stellen wir dir ein Fahrzeug für dienstliche und private Fahrten zur Verfügung.

  • Globale Teamarbeit: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg an unserer Vision, die Toniebox in alle Kinderzimmer der Welt zu bringen.

  • Come as you are: Das gilt nicht nur für den Dresscode, sondern auch für alles andere. Denn nur wo du dich wirklich wohlfühlst, kannst du auch dein Bestes geben.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Profitiere von unseren internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie einem individuellen Lernbudget, um dein Wissen kontinuierlich zu erweitern.

  • Sprachen lernen und Entspannen leicht gemacht: Verbessere deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten mit der Sprachlern-App Babbel und finde Entspannung durch unseren Zugang zur Meditations-App Calm.

  • Vergünstigungen: Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten auf unser gesamtes tonies Sortiment.

Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen.   • Perform maintenance and upgrades of test rigs

Finance & Administration Manager (m/w/d) (25-30%)

Über uns

Parkview Invest AG ist eine inhabergeführte Schweizer Investmentgesellschaft mit einem diversifizierten Portfolio aus privaten Unternehmensbeteiligungen, Immobilien, Fonds und weiteren Vermögenswerten.

Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen mehrere Gesellschaften und Beteiligungen im In- und Ausland. Im Rahmen der strategischen Weiterentwicklung konzentrieren wir uns verstärkt auf die professionelle Verwaltung bestehender Investments, die Vereinfachung unserer Unternehmensstrukturen und die effiziente Steuerung unserer Finanz- und Administrationsprozesse.

Zur Verstärkung unseres schlanken Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene, eigenständig arbeitende Persönlichkeit, die das operative Finanzmanagement unserer Gesellschaften übernimmt und unsere Geschäftsführung sowie externe Dienstleister unterstützt.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Finanzbuchhaltung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Koordination der laufenden Buchhaltung mehrerer Gesellschaften in der Schweiz und im Ausland in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Treuhändern und Steuerberatern
  • Vorbereitung und Kontrolle von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen inkl. Abstimmung von Bankkonten, Intercompany-Positionen, Darlehen, Finanzanlagen und digitalen Vermögenswerten
  • Aufbereitung von Unterlagen für Steuererklärungen, Revisionen und regulatorische Anforderungen

2. Zahlungsverkehr & Liquiditätsmanagement

  • Vorbereitung und administrative Abwicklung von Zahlungen über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Bankverbindungen (Freigabe und Zeichnung verbleiben beim Management)
  • Überwachung von Zahlungsfristen, offenen Rechnungen und wiederkehrenden Verpflichtungen inkl. Gesellschafterdarlehen und konzerninternen Finanzierungen
  • Führung von Liquiditätsübersichten und kurzfristigen Cashflow-Planungen sowie Koordination von Bankanfragen und Kontounterlagen

3. Investment Administration & Reporting

  • Pflege der finanziellen Stammdaten sowie administrative Abwicklung von Capital Calls, Ausschüttungen, Zinszahlungen und Rückflüssen
  • Abstimmung von Depot- und Bankauszügen sowie Dokumentation von Bewertungen, Beteiligungsquoten und Investmentbewegungen
  • Datenpflege und Aktualisierung standardisierter Finanz- und Portfolioübersichten als Grundlage für die Berichterstattung an Management und Verwaltungsrat

4. Administration & Prozesse

  • Koordination von KYC-, AML- und weiteren Dokumentationsanforderungen sowie Pflege von Gesellschaftsunterlagen, Verträgen und Fristen
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Vorgängen rund um Restrukturierungen, Beteiligungsübertragungen oder Gesellschaftsauflösungen
  • Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung bestehender Finance- und Administrationsprozesse sowie einheitlicher Reportingstandards

Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf den Bereichen 1–3.

Dein Profil

Fachliche Qualifikationen

  • Kaufmännische oder betriebswirtschaftliche Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen; Weiterbildung als Fachperson Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder Treuhänder/in von Vorteil
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finanzbuchhaltung, Controlling, Treasury oder Finance Operations sowie gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Rechnungswesens
  • Erfahrung mit mehreren Gesellschaften, Beteiligungsstrukturen oder internationalen Sachwerten von Vorteil; Affinität zu digitalen Vermögenswerten ein Plus
  • Sehr gute Excel- und MS-Office-Kenntnisse sowie sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Buchhaltungs- und Dokumentationssystemen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Persönliche Eigenschaften

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und sehr genaue Arbeitsweise
  • Diskretion und professioneller Umgang mit vertraulichen Finanzinformationen
  • Unternehmerisches, pragmatisches Denken und Freude daran, in einer schlanken Organisation Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Was wir bieten

  • Eine vielseitige Finance- und Administrationsrolle im Umfeld eines Schweizer Family Offices
  • Einblick in unterschiedliche Anlageklassen, Unternehmensbeteiligungen und internationale Gesellschaftsstrukturen
  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine weitgehend ortsunabhängige Arbeitsorganisation
  • Möglichkeit, bestehende Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und zu professionalisieren
  • Eine langfristig angelegte Teilzeitfunktion mit klar definiertem Verantwortungsbereich

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen von erfahrenen Finance- oder Treuhand-Fachpersonen, die eine eigenständige, vielseitige Teilzeitaufgabe in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld suchen.

jobs.title: Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Senior Scrum master

Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer - Payments Team

Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on!

Your role

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust. 

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems.

Your overall responsibilities include

  • Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code

  • Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop;

  • Taking ownership from discovery to post-production;

  • Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis;

  • Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices


Who we are looking for

In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters.

Additionally, you tick the following boxes:

  • You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience.

  • You have previous experience in the payments domain.

  • You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment.

  • You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases.

  • You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka.

  • You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build.

  • You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket.

  • You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement.

  • You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission.

Nice to have

  • Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place.

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry!

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure.

Our benefits package includes:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned).

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree.

  • Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals.

  • Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations.

  • Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees.

  • Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you!

Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned.

Here’s the next steps of the hiring process:

  • Screening call with Recruiter

  • Codility assignment and technical interview with our Engineers

  • Culture-fit conversation with the team

Senior SDK Hardware Simulator Engineer

About Us:

Innatera is a rapidly growing Dutch semiconductor company that develops ultra-efficient neuromorphic processors for AI at the edge. These microprocessors mimic the brain’s mechanisms for processing fast data streams from sensors, enabling complex turn-key sensor analytics functionalities, with 10,000x higher performance per watt than competing solutions. Innatera's technology serves as a critical enabler for next-generation use cases in the IoT, wearable, embedded, and automotive domains.

To support our rapid development roadmap, we’re looking for a Senior SDK Hardware Simulation Engineer to help drive the development of our simulation environment by enabling early application development and system validation before hardware is available. As a key member of our SDK team, you’ll be responsible for designing and building accurate, high-performance C++ hardware simulators that accurately reflect our neuromorphic architecture. This role is critical to how our software and hardware teams collaborate to test, validate, and iterate on next-gen chip designs.

We will trust you with:

  • Design and implement simulation models in modern C++ (C++17/20) to replicate the functions of neuromorphic processors, CPUs, memory systems, and other components in the full SoC;

  • Convert technical hardware specs into high-performance, verifiable software models;

  • Contribute to performance modeling: simulate power consumption, latency to identify performance bottlenecks;

  • Support early application development with accurate and configurable hardware simulation tools;

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Digital Design, Firmware, SDK) to ensure models reflect the real hardware faithfully;

  • Take ownership of simulation infrastructure quality: write unit tests, review code, and continuously improve design and maintainability;

  • Collaborate on expanding our SDK feature set, ensuring the usability of the simulation for external developers.

  • Participate in team brainstorming and contribute to other SDK development tasks as needed.

What will you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field;

  • Strong C++ development skills (including C++17/20);

  • Proven track record of designing modular, maintainable, and testable software architecture;

  • Experience in transaction-level modeling of hardware components;

  • Solid understanding of digital hardware fundamentals (e.g., CPU, instruction sets, memory systems, DMA);

  • Familiarity with hardware/software co-design concepts;

  • Working knowledge of Python (e.g., for scripting, automation, or SDK integration);

  • Great communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with RTL simulations, waveforms, and understanding how hardware behaves at the signal level;

  • Experience in low-power resource-constrained embedded programming;

  • Exposure to bare-metal firmware development, including assembly language;

  • Familiarity with RISC-V or ARM computer architectures;

Revenue Cycle Manager

About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

About the Role:

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards. You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

Experience

You'll own product messaging, narratives and launches across our product portfolio. You'll assure the team knows how to communicate new features. And you'll become the internal expert that Sales, CS, and Product all turn to when they need to know how to talk about what we build.

  • Become the product expert. Per product line, become the internal expert and pull insights back into Product. Run customer feedback loops that actually loop.

  • Build like an owner. Set up rituals & processes, create accountability, and visibility that don't exist yet.

jobs.title: Stage - Juriste chargé·e de recouvrement / contentieux
jobs.description:
Stage - Juriste chargé·e de recouvrement / contentieux

Tes missions :

Au sein du pôle Juridique et encadré·e par ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e aux procédures de pré-contentieux et de recouvrement adaptées au secteur de la copropriété.

En binôme avec les juristes du pôle, tes missions consisteront à :

• Assister le suivi du recouvrement amiable : Participer à la préparation des relances et aider à la constitution des dossiers d'échéanciers ou de protocoles d'accord.
• Épauler la gestion du contentieux : Participer à l'assemblage des pièces justificatives et à la préparation des dossiers transmis à nos partenaires (avocats, huissiers, commissaires de justice).
• Participer à l'optimisation des workflows : Découvrir nos outils de suivi automatisé et proposer tes idées pour améliorer la fluidité de nos processus.
• Contribuer au suivi & au reporting : Participer au renseignement rigoureux de nos outils de pilotage pour garantir une information claire et transparente auprès des clients.

Ton parcours d'intégration & d'apprentissage

• Deux semaines d'immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, du marché de la copropriété et de notre organisation interne.
• Formation & Accompagnement : Un suivi quotidien par ton/ta tuteur·trice et ta manager pour te former aux spécificités de la relation client et du contentieux immobilier.
• Ce que ce stage / cette alternance va t'apporter : Une vraie maîtrise pratique des procédures de recouvrement (amiable et judiciaire) appliquées à la Proptech et la gestion immobilière

Les avantages :

Les plus :

  • Salaire : 1 000€ à 1 200€ (fin d’études)

  • 2 semaines d’onboarding pour te faire découvrir le monde de la copropriété et le fonctionnement de Matera

  • Un suivi hebdomadaire par ton/ta Manager

  • Gymlib pour faire du sport à petits prix

  • Des bons plans culture avec la plateforme Leeto

La base légale :

  • Une demi-journée de congé par mois (cumulable)

  • Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50%

  • Prise en charge des transports à 50%

  • Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis

Les informations pratiques :

  • Localisation : Paris 10

  • Occasionnel sous validation du manager

  • Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois - démarrage 15 février 2027


Idéalement,

  • Tu es issu·e d'une formation en Droit,

  • Tu es très à l’aise au téléphone et tu as une bonne qualité rédactionnelle

  • Tu es force de persuasion et tu es capable de t’adapter aux situations

  • Tu es dynamique et organisé·e

Le processus de recrutement :

  1. On étudie ta candidature + entretien téléphonique (15/20 min)

  2. Rencontre avec un membre de l’équipe juridique et un Manager (30 min)

  3. Offre 🎉

jobs.description:
Stagiaire Chargé de mission - Gestion de projet européen en santé numérique H/F

L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous intégrerez le Domaine Innovation et International, au sein d’une équipe de six personnes, et assisterez la cheffe de projet Sesali. L’ANS est le point de contact national français pour la e-santé (National Contact Point for eHealth – NCPeH) au sein de l’infrastructure européenne MyHealth@EU. Elle opère le service Sesali, qui permet aux professionnel·les de santé en France de consulter de manière sécurisée la synthèse médicale de patient·es (Patient Summary) provenant d’autres pays de l’Union européenne. Le service évolue également pour intégrer la consultation des prescriptions électroniques (ePrescription). Dans la perspective de ces évolutions, de l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions avec des pays européens et de la mise en œuvre de l’Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS, European Health Data Space / EEDS), vous contribuerez au suivi du projet, à la coordination des parties prenantes et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles du service.

🎯 Missions principales

Coordination du projet européen

  • Appuyer le suivi du projet et vous familiariser avec la gestion de projets européens de grande envergure.

  • Participer à certains groupes de travail européens, représenter les positions françaises et échanger avec les homologues des autres États membres.

  • Contribuer à la coordination des parties prenantes françaises, notamment la CNAM et le ministère chargé de la Santé.

Déploiement et suivi opérationnel

  • Participer à l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions en production entre Sesali et d’autres pays : échanges avec les professionnel·les de santé, tests métier de bout en bout et coordination européenne.

  • Assurer le suivi des sprints avec les équipes de maîtrise d’œuvre : avancement, backlog et livrables.

  • Approfondir la connaissance du règlement EHDS/EEDS et analyser ses implications pour Sesali.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en lien avec le numérique, les systèmes d’information ou la gestion de projet.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit

  • Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour le numérique, les nouvelles technologies et la e-santé.

  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur et d’un bon sens de l’organisation, avec une capacité à prioriser.

  • Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse, êtes curieux·se et force de proposition.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les échanges avec des interlocuteurs français et européens.

Entrepreneur Intern

About SeeSicht Gmbh

SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds.

Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh

You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment.

What you will do

  • You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes.

  • You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend.

  • MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects.

The timeline — how it works

  • Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on.

  • From month 13 — the stake: the internship is over and you get a stake in the company, up to 10% equity, with a base salary of at least CHF 5,000/month — plus the up to 10% profit share on top. If a project becomes a real company, a senior position is possible, depending on how you develop.

What you get from day 1
