jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
jobs.description:
Senior Partnership Manager Payments

Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

  • Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

  • Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

  • Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

  • Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU?

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer.

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week.

jobs.title: Director, Industry Practice Lead - Higher Education
jobs.description:
Director, Industry Practice Lead - Higher Education

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead – Higher Education, you will serve as Panopto’s trusted domain authority and top-of-funnel growth engine across the global higher education sector. Operating as a senior individual contributor (P5) reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will bridge academic practice, campus technology strategy, and product capability. You will serve as a sought-after expert in academic technology, building peer-level trust with Provosts, CIOs, and Vice Provosts of Academic Technology to open new pipeline and articulate how video-based knowledge management elevates teaching, learning, and student outcomes.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Top-of-Funnel Pipeline Creation & Industry Authority: Represent Panopto as a leading voice at major academic gatherings (e.g., EDUCAUSE, OLC, POD Network), executive roundtables, and campus panels. Activate your network of higher education leaders to build brand trust, generate new institutional prospects, and expand the top-of-funnel pipeline.

  • Strategic Subject Matter Expertise in Deals: Partner with Account Executives on high-profile institutional opportunities as an academic peer and product expert. Seamlessly discuss pedagogical trends, campus IT vision, accessibility mandates, and Jobs to Be Done (JTBD) to build trust without carrying direct deal-closing responsibility.

  • Campus Value & Adoption Advisory: Conduct strategic health and usage reviews with existing institutional accounts to evaluate platform adoption, understand academic goals, and prescribe tailored solution strategies that improve usage across departments and uncover expansion potential.

  • Domain Frameworks & Product Voice: Develop practitioner-focused domain playbooks, usage frameworks, and industry point-of-view content centered on campus pain points. Synthesize field signals regarding accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA), lecture capture infrastructure, LMS workflows, and AI in pedagogy to guide internal Product and Product Marketing teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a baseline assessment of higher education buying priorities, establish an operational rhythm with Sales and Product Marketing, and participate in select high-profile institutional sales discussions.

  • Within 6 Months: Publish initial industry point-of-view content on higher ed video trends, represent Panopto at key academic conferences to build top-of-funnel pipeline, and deliver solution adoption recommendations for major campus accounts.

  • Within 1 Year: Drive measurable growth in influenced campus pipeline, brand authority, and institutional expansion across top-tier colleges and university systems.

  • Your Legacy: Build a scalable, repeatable higher education practice model that positions Panopto as the undeniable standard for academic video technology.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

At Panopto, we believe in simple elegance in everything we do. We do not just talk about accountability; we live it. You will be joining a collaborative team of seasoned Account Executives and Revenue leaders who are deeply embedded in the education sector.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead, you will be the bridge between technical capability and business transformation. You will partner directly with our Account Executives to inspire leaders, demonstrate the value of our platform, and bring our AI-driven video knowledge vision to life. This is an opportunity to serve as a trusted advisor to key buyers, shape our go-to-market strategy, and serve as the voice of the customer back to our Product and Engineering teams.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Educational Technology, Higher Education Administration, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 8+ years of total experience combining higher education leadership (e.g., Academic Technology, Distance Education, Campus IT) with 3+ years of commercial GTM experience at an ed-tech provider.

  • Technical & Product Proficiency: Deep expertise in Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, Moodle), video infrastructure (Panopto, Kaltura, Echo360, YuJa), and campus IT architecture. Ability to demonstrate platform capabilities through a pedagogical and user-outcome lens.

jobs.description:
Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning

What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

Contentstack is a growth-stage enterprise SaaS company with an ambitious goal of reaching $250M ARR. Getting there means rethinking how we operate and scale our go-to-market (GTM) organization - not simply increasing costs as revenue grows.

To support this vision, we recently established our GTM Strategy & Systems (GSS) team under the Office of the CEO. This team brings strategy, systems, and execution together under one leader, connecting Revenue Operations, Analytics, GTM Applications, and a newly formed GTM Engineering capability.

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Leader, Strategy & Planning to build the planning and performance-management foundation that powers this organization. You’ll work closely with the CRO, Finance, and GTM leaders to turn business objectives into actionable plans, establish a clear view of performance, and help the business identify and address opportunities and risks early.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys creating structure, challenging assumptions, and turning complex data into decisions that drive growth. If you're excited to help shape how a scaling enterprise SaaS company operates, we'd love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Lead GTM planning: Own annual planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and incentive-plan design. Build scenario models that clearly communicate tradeoffs, dependencies, and assumptions to GTM and Finance leadership.
  • Drive performance management: Establish a rigorous forecasting approach and evaluate performance against the plan across pipeline, productivity, bookings, retention, and expansion. Identify gaps and partner with GTM leaders to determine what needs to change.
  • Turn insights into action: Translate performance trends into clear recommendations, helping leadership understand risks, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.
  • Establish measurement and governance: Define and maintain cross-functional KPIs that ensure Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success are working from consistent metrics and business definitions.
  • Improve cross-functional alignment: Identify gaps in reporting, measurement, and assumptions, and work with stakeholders to resolve issues and document agreed-upon standards.
  • Leverage AI and automation: Build agent-enabled workflows that streamline recurring analysis, surface meaningful changes, and make business insights easier to access.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

  • 8–15+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, GTM Finance, or a similarly analytical role within a B2B SaaS organization.
  • Direct ownership of annual GTM planning across capacity, territories, quotas, and compensation design, with the ability to confidently defend planning assumptions with CRO and CFO-level stakeholders.
  • Strong command of forecasting, funnel economics, and SaaS growth metrics, with the hands-on ability to analyze complex pipeline, bookings, and customer data.
  • Experience with demand-generation metrics and the Marketing-to-Sales handoff, including funnel-stage definitions, conversion rates, and lead routing.
  • Hands-on experience building or significantly shaping segmentation, scoring, or attribution models, with the ability to assess the reliability of inputs and effectiveness of outputs.
  • Experience building and deploying AI or agentic workflows that expand analytical capacity, streamline recurring analysis, or improve business decision-making.
  • You’re a high-agency builder who enjoys creating new capabilities, raising standards, and rethinking processes as the business evolves.
  • You build trust across functions and are comfortable challenging assumptions with senior leaders when the data tells a different story.
  • You know when a directional answer is enough to move forward, when precision matters, and how to communicate uncertainty.
  • You stay close to the details while keeping broader business objectives in view, and know when to gather input versus when to take ownership and move forward.
  • You’ve built trusted partnerships with CROs and GTM leaders and know how to influence decisions while plans are still taking shape.
  • You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture!

Salary for this role ranges between $155,000-195,000 based on skill set and experience

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

Staff Web Engineer, Marketing

Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

Staff Web Engineer Marketing

About the role

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI and deepgram.com is where the world meets it. The site is our digital front door, showcasing our products, brand moments, and pricing information, and it drives the company's self-serve revenue.

You'll be the person who knows the site inside out. You'll own the repo, the architecture, the Sanity environments, and the QA bar — and act as the code-review gate for day-to-day page and content work. The team is small but scaling. You will be working on the Web team reporting into the Head of Brand & Awareness and closely collaborating with our Senior Web Manager, product, marketing, sales, and external development partners.

Most critically, as an AI company, you must be AI-native. Agents and AI tooling are your go-to in how you choose to build, review, and QA. We are aiming to build a machine-first, voice-first site experience. It’s an exciting time to join the web team.

What you'll do

  • Own the deepgram.com codebase end to end — the Next.js application (front and back end), the GitHub repo, branching and CI/CD, and code review

  • Optimize and maintain Sanity CMS architecture — schemas, the reusable module library, the staging and production environments and publishing workflow

  • Run the global design system, component library, Vercel platform and spearhead AI integrations. Experienced with global CSS systems.

  • Build and run the site's QA program — starting with a well-structured and scalable staging environment that keeps a marketing site launch-ready at all times

  • Lead internationalization and localization efforts — language-locale URL and routing architecture, hreflang, and the path from i18n plumbing to localized (l10n) content

  • Assist in technical SEO — site architecture, redirects, Core Web Vitals — with on-page SEO executed by content partners inside your review gate

  • Ensure LLM discoverability (AEO) — the site's structured data, metadata, and content architecture must serve answer engines as well as people

  • Technical infrastructure for experimentation — develop the mechanisms to support the site's experimentation program

  • Marketing Ops partnership — implementation of forms, gated content, and attribution instrumentation (GTM, GA4, HubSpot)

  • Cybersecurity posture — maintain security and run routine safety audits across dependencies and scripts

  • High-velocity shipping — ship complex site improvements and launch campaign pages in a product-driven atmosphere

  • AI-native workflow — use agents in your daily build process and create tooling for safe marketing publishing

We are looking for candidates with:

  • Marketing web development background — ownership of marketing sites, not just product surfaces

  • Enterprise repository ownership: branching strategy, CI/CD, and a strong code-review culture

  • Headless CMS architecture — Next.js with Sanity strongly preferred

  • Modern React ecosystem for the web

  • Vercel as a production platform

  • AI-native development — ability to demonstrate concrete use of AI agents and tooling in your workflow

  • High level of ownership & accountability — a hand raiser who’s ready to join an ambitious team and company

  • Technical leadership — directing or reviewing the work of agency developers

Our ideal candidates also have:

  • Prior experience with internationalization (i18n/l10n): URL architecture, locale routing, and multi-region infrastructure

  • Familiarity with A/B testing on production marketing sites

  • Interest in voice AI and the future of voice-interactive web experiences

Ad Operations Specialist, Audio

Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Ad Operations Specialist, Audio at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is one of the largest Podcast advertisers in the world, and we’ve been hard at work at scaling Radio and Streaming, as well. We’re looking for someone to help us manage and continue to evolve our ad operations for podcast, radio and digital radio advertising strategies in our US and Non-US markets. You are organized and can manage a large amount of moving pieces and deadlines.

You have experience with advertising operations, preferably in audio. You are knowledgeable on the processes of advertising involving media flighting, creative, campaign launch, and billing/reconciling. You are organized and can help manage information for hundreds of shows from an operational standpoint. You are innovative and utilize AI to improve efficiency where it makes sense, and are open-minded to creating new solutions. You love a challenge and are a great team-player.

What will you do?

  • Work alongside the Audio Strategy team by managing all operations as it relates to our podcast, radio and digital radio advertising in our US and Non-US markets. Examples include:
    • IO & Budget Management: Process insertion orders by entering the data and information of the buys into our systems, generate PO order #s with the accounting department, and assist with Billing/Reconciling at EOM to ensure all partners are paid correctly and on time.
    • Develop & Maintain QA Management: Help ensure that our ads run correctly by utilizing our QA and pixel tools like Podscribe.
    • Compliance: Manage compliance efforts for our channels ranging from brand safety checks on new partners to ensuring all creative is compliance approved, and all shows are adhering to our policies.

  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

  • Innovative mindset with a knack for improving systems and workflows for efficiency.
  • Incredibly organized and efficient with a large number of tasks and deadlines.

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)

🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr sind als nur ein Job!

Wir bei voize sind überzeugt: Das Wertvollste, was wir Pflegekräften zurückgeben können ist Zeit – Zeit, um sich zu kümmern, Beziehungen aufzubauen und wirklich präsent zu sein. Heute geht diese Zeit für Bürokratie und unübersichtliche Systeme verloren, die sie von dem abhalten, worauf es eigentlich ankommt: den Menschen.

Genau das wollen wir ändern. Wir bauen AI-Companions, die digitale Arbeitsabläufe nahtlos übernehmen. Wir ersetzen Menschen nicht durch Technologie – wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Unsere Mission wird von einer Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar getragen, angeführt von Balderton Capital und mit Beteiligung von HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Heute vertrauen über 2.000 Einrichtungen auf voize, und mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen setzen unseren KI-Companion ein, um ihren Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern.

Als dynamisches Team verbinden wir erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert. Und jetzt suchen wir dich, um diese Mission mit uns weiterzutragen!

💡 Deine Mission: Du verantwortest den Erstkontakt und baust unsere Pipeline auf

Wir suchen eine proaktive und empathische Persönlichkeit als Sales Development Representative (SDR), die den ersten Schritt im Vertriebsprozess übernimmt: herausfinden, wer unsere nächsten Kund:innen sein sollten, den passenden Weg zu ihnen entwickeln und mitgestalten, wie sich unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie weiterentwickelt, während wir in neue Segmente wachsen.

Hier bekommt niemand eine Liste und ein Skript in die Hand gedrückt. Du entwickelst dein eigenes Bild vom Markt, testest, was funktioniert, und spielst deine Erkenntnisse direkt in unsere Vertriebsarbeit zurück.

Für diese Position suchen wir jemanden, der hybrid aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten kann.

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest deine eigene Outbound-Strategie für den Healthcare-Bereich – von der Account-Recherche bis zum qualifizierten Termin

  • Du qualifizierst Opportunities anhand klarer Kriterien und übergibst nur Termine, die für unsere Account Executives wirklich spruchreif sind

  • Du dokumentierst jedes Gespräch und jedes Ergebnis sauber und vollständig in unserem CRM – deine Daten beeinflussen Entscheidungen weit über deine eigene Pipeline hinaus

  • Du bringst Kund:innen- und Marktsignale direkt in unsere GTM-Strategie ein – dein Blick auf den Markt verändert, wie wir ihn angehen, nicht nur, wie du arbeitest

  • Du verfolgst Entwicklungen in der Branche und übersetzt sie über die Zeit in eine schärfere Positionierung

    🤝 Dein Profil – was du mitbringst

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld

  • Sicherheit bei Cold Calls und ein professioneller Umgang mit Absagen

  • Neugier darauf, die Bedürfnisse deiner Gesprächspartner:innen zu verstehen und mit unserer Lösung zusammenzubringen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommst auf den Punkt und machst komplexe Themen verständlich

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. We want n8n to be the reference for how this is done, without compromising quality, resilience or trust. Your main goal is to make that real.

This is a Staff individual contributor role in Developer Platform and the technical driving force behind ACDC (Agent-centric Development Cycle), our engineering-wide initiative for agentic development. Nobody has a playbook for this yet. You'll write ours.

You won't start from zero. Agents wired into Linear already automate around 80% of the development cycle on one of our developer platform projects, alongside pilots for insight, feature-flag and PR-review agents and a shared agent harness. Your job is to take this from promising experiments to the way n8n builds software.

This role is for someone who thinks about this problem constantly. You run agents all day, rebuild your own workflow every time the frontier moves, and have more ideas than time.

You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person.

What you'll do

Set direction and own the outcome

  • Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data.

  • Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows.

  • Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend.

  • Make decisions where requirements are incomplete and the trade-offs between autonomy, reliability, security and review effort are still emerging.

  • Build alignment through technical proposals, clear decisions and working software, and report progress and impact to engineering leadership.

Build the foundations

  • Design and build isolated execution environments where agents can work with the right access to code, tools and context, without exposing secrets or sensitive systems.

  • Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling.

  • Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need.

Integrate agents into how we work

  • Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types.

  • Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers.

  • Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle.

  • Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change.

  • Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed.

Measure what works

  • Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk.

  • Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction.

  • Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🔥 Frontier obsession: You live at the frontier. You try new models and tools as they land, and you have strong, evidence-backed opinions on what's real and what's hype.

  • 🧭 Staff-scope ownership: You’ve led complex platform, DevEx or engineering productivity initiatives across teams, from defining the problem to sustained adoption and measurable impact, where there was no established approach to follow.

  • 🤖 Agentic depth: You use coding agents daily as a power user, and you've built infrastructure around them, such as repo context and instructions, tool or MCP integrations, sandboxed execution or agent workflows in CI, that other engineers rely on.

  • 🎯 Product mindset for internal platforms: You treat engineers as your customers. You start from real friction, prioritise by impact, make build-vs-buy calls, weigh cost against value, and let adoption tell you whether something works.

  • 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture.

  • 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs.

  • 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't work. You care about outcomes, not lines of AI-generated code.

  • ✍️ Writing that changes decisions: Your technical proposals and documentation have shifted what teams did.

Nice-to-haves

  • 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js or JavaScript monorepo.

  • ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, test infrastructure, preview environments or internal developer platforms.

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Growing a team: You've mentored engineers or helped shape a new team as an initiative grew beyond one person.

  • 🌍 Open-source communities: You have contributed to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.

  • 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling and customer trust are central.

  • 🔗 Workflow automation: You're familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration or developer-facing products.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe's fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework and developer workflows that decide whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You'll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-its-kind role, you'll set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both our internal engineering and n8n's product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - iOS/Swift

[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

Join us as a Senior Product Engineer (iOS/Swift) to build the mobile app that 750,000 customers across Europe use to run their business finances every day, and to keep it fast and reliable as it grows.

Impact: Your work ships to the customers who use Qonto's iOS app for their daily payments and cash management. You will join one of our squads, each owning a clear product scope. You'll work with a team lead, Product, Design, and Frontend and Backend engineers. Squads have 5 to 10 people.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end to end: Take mobile features from technical design to production, on critical architecture and UI work that customers use daily.

  • Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and lead new initiatives in your squad's scope.

  • Raise quality: Keep the codebase healthy through continuous refactoring, unit tests and snapshot tests.

  • Migrate to SwiftUI: Move screens to SwiftUI (MVVM, async/await) as part of the ongoing migration.

  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with back-end teams, designers and product managers so the whole team shares one vision.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • iOS expertise: You have proven experience as a native mobile engineer, with strong Swift skills and a deep understanding of the iOS SDK and development lifecycle. You'll use it daily on a 100% Swift app.

  • Quality-driven development: You're committed to best practices such as unit testing (XCTest, FBSnapshots), clean code and SOLID principles. This matters in a codebase with 30,000+ unit tests.

  • Pragmatic problem solving: You deliver tangible value in a fast-moving context, and you pick the simplest solution that works.

  • Collaboration: You communicate clearly in English and work well with technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • Curiosity: You enjoy learning new technologies and use AI tools to raise the bar, not only to go faster.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A mature, modern codebase: 100% Swift, MVP and Clean Architecture, 35+ independent modules and a centralized design system. New screens use SwiftUI, and 80+ are already migrated.

  • Solid engineering practices: Upfront technical design, team code reviews, 450+ snapshot tests, and CI/CD on GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, Fastlane and Tuist.

  • Autonomy inside a clear mission: Each project has one team lead and a clear mission, and your squad decides how it works. We use Kaizen and PDCA to improve together, following the Qonto Way.

  • AI in your daily work: Every engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and LLMs are part of our development workflow.

  • A large mobile community: You'll be part of a 140-strong mobile engineering community within a 500-person Product Engineering department. You get mentorship, Tech Weeklies and Monthlies, and conference opportunities. Read about our mobile performance indicators here.

➡️ Your future manager

We hire for several squads and domains, so you'll meet your future team lead during the interview process. They run one clear project mission and hand you full ownership of a product scope. You'll talk to them directly before you decide.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

Strategic Partnerships Lead - UK

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

Rillet is hiring its first partnerships leader in the UK. You will kickstart our partner motion in the market from day one: choosing where to start, signing the first partners, and building results and momentum so we can staff up a team around you.

This is a founding, high-agency role that will span all three of Rillet's partner channels in the UK:

  • Accounting & Advisory: CPA, chartered accountancy, and ERP consulting firms that recommend and implement Rillet for their clients

  • Private Equity & Venture Capital: investors who back finance-led high growth companies and want to tool them with the best available technology

  • Technology: the fintech and Office of the CFO software ecosystem that integrates with Rillet and co-sells with us

You will work with partner executives on vision and business-case creation, and with front-line leaders on execution. You will work closely with the US partnerships leads for each channel, who will share playbooks, frameworks, and introductions, and with Product, Sales, Marketing, Solutions, and Customer Success to make every partner relationship turn into pipeline and revenue. You will build on our existing partnerships in the US – with firms such as the Big 4 and top PE firms – and expand our presence in their ecosystems in the UK.

This is a highly visible role internally and externally. What you build in the UK becomes the template for how Rillet launches partner programs in new markets.

What You'll Do

  • Launch the UK partner motion: Create a market map of key partners and channel-specific motions, and execute relentlessly to get early wins

  • Generate revenue day 1: Partnerships is a critical go-to-market play for Rillet, and it’s important we are commercially oriented from the start

  • Develop Rillet’s value exchange: Our partnerships are built on trust and reciprocity; you will identify what major partners care about and align Rillet’s plans to bring them value

  • Expand core capabilities and capacity: Work with partners to deepen our product capabilities and our implementation capacity in the UK

  • Establish Rillet as the market leader: Build alliances with the top firms and technology companies, and notable individuals, to win mindshare among addressable clients. As we have done in the US – any trusted advisor or PE firm or OCFO tech company would recommend Rillet

  • Host and attend industry events: Build relationships and presence in the UK and become the face of partnerships for the market

  • Enable Rillet’s GTM functions to work seamlessly with partners: Co-sell, implementations, integrations, customizations – wherever a partner can help us win, Sales, Marketing, Solutions, and Product should know whom to go to and how

  • Provide critical product feedback from the front lines: Rillet’s partners are top notch. They understand customer needs, and our job is to bake their feedback into everything we do

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in strategic partnerships at a high-growth B2B software company, or at a top finance-focused private equity firm

  • Background in analytically rigorous professions – investing, management consulting, investment banking, or product strongly preferred

  • Track record of launching and scaling partner programs from scratch, ideally as a first or early hire in a new market

  • Demonstrated ability to turn partnerships into real commercial outcomes: partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, not just relationships

  • Experience with at least one of our channels (accounting and ERP consulting firms, PE / VC investors, or technology and integration partners), and the curiosity to learn the other two quickly

  • Established network in the UK finance, accounting, or software ecosystem is a strong plus

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and equivalent executives

  • Proven track record of thriving in ambiguity: creating structure, taking action, and driving measurable results

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration and impact

  • Strong internal drive and low ego, with a team-first, growth mindset. Some call this an "Athlete" mentality

  • Willingness to travel across the UK and Europe, and to the US as needed

Life at Rillet

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

  • Curiosité technique et capacité à être force de proposition.
  • Bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Assistant Product Owner – Santé.fr H/F
jobs.description:
Stagiaire Assistant Product Owner – Santé.fr H/F

L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe en charge de Santé.fr, au sein de la Direction des opérations (DOPS). Composée notamment d’une direction de programme, d’une équipe produit et de responsables de projet et de déploiement, elle contribue à faire évoluer le site national d’information en santé destiné au grand public. Vous assisterez le Product Owner dans le suivi du produit, la gestion des anomalies et la coordination des évolutions, afin d’améliorer continuellement l’expérience des utilisateurs et la qualité des informations proposées.

🎯 Missions principales

Suivi du produit et du backlog

  • Aider à qualifier, créer et suivre les tickets d’anomalie et les demandes d’évolution.

  • Assurer la mise à jour de la documentation associée aux tickets et aux sujets traités.

  • Contribuer au suivi de l’avancement des corrections et des évolutions avec les équipes concernées.

Coordination et amélioration continue

  • Participer aux réunions de suivi et aux échanges avec les parties prenantes du produit.

  • Contribuer à l’analyse des retours utilisateurs et à l’identification des améliorations possibles.

  • Participer à la préparation des éléments de suivi et de synthèse utiles au pilotage du produit.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, avec un intérêt pour la gestion de produit web ou la gestion de projet numérique.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous avez une appétence pour le numérique, le secteur de la santé et les services numériques destinés au grand public.

  • Vous êtes curieux·se, adaptable et appréciez les environnements évolutifs.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe, les échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés et la compréhension des besoins utilisateurs.

  • Vous faites preuve d’organisation et de bonnes capacités de synthèse.

jobs.description:
Senior Account Manager

Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

Er komen meer leads binnen dan we nu kunnen opvolgen. Daarom zoeken we een Sales Development Representative die het eerste gesprek opent.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

jobs.title: Care Navigator
jobs.description:
Care Navigator

The Care Navigator is responsible for conducting social care screenings, eligibility assessments, referral coordination, and ongoing care navigation activities for Medicaid members and other eligible populations participating in Social Care Network (SCN), 1115 Waiver, ILOS, Value-Added Benefit (VAB), and related programs. This work is completed telephonically.

The Care Navigator provides person-centered, culturally responsive, trauma-informed telephonic and technology-enabled navigation services designed to identify unmet health-related social needs and connect individuals to appropriate community-based resources and services. Responsibilities include screening completion, eligibility verification, referral placement, closed-loop referral follow-up, documentation, consent management, and coordination with community-based organizations, managed care organizations, and healthcare partners.

Documentation and tracking activities will occur within both internal and external technology platforms. The Care Navigator is expected to maintain compliance with organizational policies, state program requirements, productivity standards, quality metrics, and confidentiality regulations.

The Care Navigator reports to the Care Navigation Program Manager. This is a remote position that may be located anywhere in the United States but CST or EST hours will be worked. Occasional travel to offices in Iowa and New York may be required.

Hourly wage: $23/hour

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to

  • Conduct standardized, health-related social needs screenings in accordance with state and program requirements
  • Complete eligibility assessments and supporting documentation for social care services and enhanced navigation programs
  • Initiate, monitor, and close referrals within designated referral management platforms
  • Accurately document and record service activities, encounters, and time spent in accordance with program billing and reporting requirements
  • Perform closed-loop referral follow-up activities to confirm service connection and identify unresolved barriers
  • Conduct outreach attempts and follow-up activities in accordance with program timelines and documentation standards
  • Educate clients regarding available community resources, benefits, and social care services
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, and community-based organizations to support continuity of care
  • Escalate complex cases, urgent social needs, or safety concerns to supervisory or clinical staff as appropriate
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, confidentiality requirements, and all applicable state and federal regulations
  • Meet productivity, timeliness, documentation, and quality assurance standards established by the organization and program requirements
  • Participate in ongoing training, workflow updates, and quality improvement initiatives
  • Support reassessment and renewal activities as required by program guidelines

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in a healthcare, social service, or behavioral health setting; this may include any role with direct client contact
  • Ability to engage individuals experiencing complex social and health-related barriers with empathy and professionalism
  • Ability to maintain accurate and detailed documentation in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Prior work that included in-person or telephonic interactions with clients or patients
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other standard office technology platforms
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to prioritize competing tasks and projects effectively
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound professional judgment
  • Ability to routinely use standard office equipment and technology, including laptop computers and smartphones

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Training or certification in Trauma-Informed Care, Motivational Interviewing, and/or Crisis De-escalation techniques
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing food insecurity, substance use disorders, behavioral health needs, homelessness, and/or transition from incarceration or institutional settings
  • Previous experience providing telephonic screenings, care navigation, care management, vocational rehab, or health coaching services

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Our team members enjoy:

  • Eligible for Referral Bonuses starting Day 1
  • Weekly paychecks
  • PTO, 401k, & a Full benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer 

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified.

  • Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run.

  • Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results.

  • Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities.

  • Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team.

  • Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence.

  • Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness.

  • Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers.

  • Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following:


What we would love to see from you

  • Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns.

  • Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it.

  • Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).

  • Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics).

  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.

  • Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles.

  • Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification.

  • Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

Merge is the leading provider of agentic tools and customer-facing integrations for frontier LLMs, Fortune 500 organizations, and B2B SaaS companies.

Our platform offers two core products: Merge for Product, and Merge for Workforce. Merge for Product enables teams to ship AI features and integrations at massive scale. Merge for Workforce helps engineering teams govern AI access at the company level. Merge's enterprise-grade platform handles the entire integration lifecycle, from authentication and security to monitoring and maintenance. Thousands of companies trust Merge to accelerate product development, unblock sales, reduce customer churn, and save engineering resources—allowing them to focus on their core product.

Merge is seeking an experienced DevOps engineer to join our Foundations Engineering team. The right person will be a key player in driving new data and services strategies when it comes to infrastructure and AWS decisions for Merge, as well as being critical to delivering on re-architecture strategy as we scale the company.

What will you be doing?

  • With reliability and scalability in mind, work with the rest of the engineering team to produce highly performant architectures that extend to some of our largest customers, reading and writing millions of rows per second across numerous databases, workers, and services

  • Participate in roadmapping, architecture, and planning discussions

  • Produce high-quality, production-ready, maintainable infrastructure as code

  • Lead large projects from initial inception to production

  • Run production systems at scale

  • Participate in on-call rotation and infrastructure maintenance

What experience is required?

  • 4+ years of full-time DevOps experience

  • Deep experience with AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure, Terraform, and Kubernetes

  • Ability to own the planning and deployment of highly scalable systems

  • Familiarity with some or all of the following technologies: AWS Aurora, Redshift, Kinesis, EC2, EKS, ECS, Redis, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics

Compensation

  • The cash compensation range for this role is $155,000-$185,000.

  • Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO + 10 company holidays

  • 401K Plan

Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Berlin zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Berlin und Umgebung für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebserfahrung im Vertrieb von komplexen Praxissoftware-Lösungen (SaaS) mit und verstehst, was Deine Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen beschäftigt. Ein Wohnort in Berlin (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

jobs.description:
Technical Services Engineer - Interoperabilität (x/f/m)

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Du hast ein starkes technisches Wissen und Lust, Dich tief in die deutsche Healthcare-IT einzuarbeiten? Dann bist Du hier richtig.

Im Technical Services arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Doctolib-Plattform und der deutschen Healthcare-IT-Landschaft. Du löst komplexe Integrationsprobleme, unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei technischen Herausforderungen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Doctolib reibungslos in die Infrastruktur unserer Kund:innen integriert ist.

Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben 

Du bist technische Ansprechperson rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur – von der Schnittstellen-Architektur über Kartenverwaltung bis hin zu Gematik-Standards. Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

  • Produkte, die laufen: Du supportest Doctolib-Lösungen rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur. und sorgst dafür, dass sie korrekt konfiguriert sind – und wenn doch mal etwas hakt, findest du heraus, warum.

  • Komplexe Probleme, echte Lösungen: Interoperabilitätsprobleme mit Konnektoren und APIs gehören zu deinem Alltag – du arbeitest eng mit IT-Service-Partnern zusammen und bringst auch schwierige Fälle zum Abschluss.

  • Tiefer tauchen, sauber dokumentieren: Du analysierst technische Herausforderungen eigenständig, hältst alles strukturiert in Jira fest und arbeitest direkt mit den Entwicklerteams zusammen, um Fehler nachhaltig zu beheben.

  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Buzzword: Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv, um schneller zu Lösungen zu kommen und Dir fundiertes Wissen aufzubauen – effizient und zielgerichtet.

  • Wissen, das bleibt: Du teilst dein Know-how proaktiv mit internen Teams, damit Probleme gar nicht erst entstehen und unsere Kund:innen das bestmögliche Erlebnis haben.

Dein Profil

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • API-Integration und Troubleshooting sind für dich kein Neuland – du hast echte Erfahrung damit, Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Wir suchen Dich als Revenue Operations Lead für unser Revenue Operations Team in Berlin. Doctolib bietet Arztpraxen in Deutschland ein Portfolio, das von Terminmanagement und Patientenkommunikation über KI-Assistenten für Telefon und Dokumentation bis zur vollständigen Praxissoftware reicht, und vertreibt es über mehrere Sales Motions parallel: Field Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Success und einen jungen Partnerkanal. Revenue Operations bündelt die kommerzielle Planung und Steuerung für alle Sales Motions, von Zielen und Kapazität über Pipeline und Performance bis zu Pricing und Packaging.

Als Revenue Operations Lead verantwortest Du die kommerzielle Steuerung von Inside Sales, vom Neugeschäft bis zu Upsell und Retention im Bestand, und bist dort die Ansprechperson für das Leadership, wenn aus Zahlen Entscheidungen werden. Zugleich übernimmst Du Themen, die über alle Motions laufen, etwa gemeinsame KPI-Definitionen oder die jährliche Planungsrunde, und gestaltest unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie mit: in welche Segmente, Motions und Kanäle wir investieren.

Nach sechs Monaten steuert Inside Sales auf einer gemeinsamen Zahlenbasis mit festen Routinen, die nächste Planungsrunde mit Zielen und Kapazität steht auf nachvollziehbaren Regeln, und mindestens eine wiederkehrende Steuerungsaufgabe läuft KI-gestützt.
