Contrôleur(se) de Gestion Industriel(le) Agroalimentaire confirmé(e)

Rejoignez l'aventure ALMMA !

ALMMA, c'est la rencontre de deux pépites de l'agroalimentaire français : Foo Seng (spécialiste des snacks asiatiques) et Varachaux (expert des produits élaborés viande & végétal). Résultat : plus de 100 collaborateurs, 3 usines, et une ambition assumée : accélérer, vite et fort, en interne comme en externe, aux côtés de nos actionnaires et d'un fonds d'investissement qui partage notre vision.

Notre ADN ! L'énergie d'une start-up, la solidité d'un outil industriel. Pas de contradiction ici : on avance à la vitesse d'une équipe qui construit, avec la rigueur d'un groupe qui pilote des volumes, des flux et des échéances réelles.

Le poste

Au sein d'une équipe finance nouvellement créée et en plein déploiement, vous êtes le/la partenaire privilégié(e) de nos usines. C'est une création de poste clé, conçue pour un profil qui aime faire parler la donnée au cœur des ateliers de fabrication ! Rattaché(e) directement au CFO Groupe

En clair : une feuille blanche, un vrai mandat de builder. Vous ne reprenez pas un système existant, vous le créez, vous le modernisez, vous le simplifiez.

Vos missions

Envie de faire parler la donnée sur le terrain ALMMA !

Véritable chef d'orchestre de la performance industrielle, vous co-construisez nos indicateurs et accompagnez nos équipes de production pour maximiser la création de valeur :

Vos Missions :

Calcul & Analyse Fine des Coûts de Revient :

Pilotage des Écarts & Performance des Ateliers :

Proximité & Business Partnering Usine :

Processus Budgétaire & Suivi des Investissements (CAPEX) :

  • Modéliser le ROI de nos projets d'investissements machines/automatisation et suivre la réalisation des enveloppes CAPEX.

Gestion & Valorisation des Stocks :

Esprit builder, passion du terrain, rigueur, culture produit et énergie positive

jobs.title: Lead Acquisition B2C
jobs.description:
Lead Acquisition B2C

Green-Got en bref

Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement.

En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction.

  • Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide.

  • Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites.

  • Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi.

Quelques repères :

  • Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres

  • 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion

  • 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record

Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests.

  • Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

  • Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier.

  • Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut.

  • Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique.

  • Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement.

  • Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

L'équipe autour de toi

Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires :

  1. Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre

  2. Acquisition haut de funnel : toi

  3. CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes

Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management.

Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider.
Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise.

Ton profil

Indispensable

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en acquisition, growth ou traffic management (tes side projects comptent)

  • Tu es un faiseur : tu livres, tu shippes, tu passes vite d'un sujet à l'autre

  • Tu es data driven. Tu as de l'instinct, mais tu valides tout avec la data.

  • Tu utilises l’IA au quotidien et tu as déjà construit des outils ou des automatisations avec.

  • Tu es autonome, débrouillard et problem solver : face à un problème, tu trouves une solution

  • Tu as un mindset business : tu raisonnes en chiffre d'affaires, pas en vanity metrics

  • Tu t'intéresses vraiment à la finance.

  • Tu es sensible aux enjeux d'écologie, de transition à l'échelle française et européenne, et de santé

  • Tu es créatif, proactif, organisé et rigoureux

  • Tu parles anglais

Ce qui nous fera vraiment craquer

  • Tu as déjà lancé tes propres projets : une boutique e-commerce, un site d'affiliation, des side projects. Tu as tenté des choses.

  • Tu viens d'agence, mais tu as des projets à côté et tu veux maintenant aller plus loin : un seul annonceur, beaucoup de budget, de vrais résultats à porter.

  • Tu as déjà travaillé dans la finance ou la fintech, et tu connais les règles de la communication sur les produits financiers.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour toi si…

  • Tu préfères concevoir la stratégie et laisser d'autres l'exécuter

  • Tu présentes tes résultats en clics, en impressions ou en leads sans te soucier du resultat final

  • Tu attends qu'on te dise quoi faire et quoi tester

Ce qu'on t'offre

  • Un package entre 52 et 62 k€ (fixe + variable) et des BSPCE

  • Paris, avec 1 jour de télétravail par semaine

  • Mutuelle santé Alan

  • Un vrai budget, de vrais canaux qui tournent déjà, et la liberté de les faire grandir

  • Un mentor en interne et une équipe aux compétences complémentaires

  • Un métier qui fait bouger l'argent dans le bon sens

Le process

  1. Un exercice à faire chez toi

  2. Un call avec le Head of Growth et le lead CRM

  3. Un entretien avec le Head of Brand

  4. Un entretien avec la CMO

  5. Un entretien avec le CEO

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)
jobs.description:
Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • Opening the US market

The problem

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

  • The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

  • You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

  • You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

  • First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

  • First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

  • 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Möglichkeit, von unseren Büros in Genf oder Bern aus zu arbeiten.

Du begeisterst dich für Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, möchtest aber über die Zahlen hinausgehen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung von Unternehmen beitragen?

Bei Fidigit stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt, denn wir bieten dank der Einführung von Abacus ERP und unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden einen aussergewöhnlichen Service. Als Teil der Fidinam-Gruppe, eines führenden Beratungsunternehmens in den Bereichen Steuern, Unternehmen, Immobilien und digitale Beratung in der Schweiz, sind wir mit mehr als 15 Standorten weltweit und über 300 Beratern hervorragend aufgestellt.

Mit Standorten in Bern, Genf, Lugano, Luzern und Zürich sind wir der einzige Abacus-Vertriebspartner, der in allen drei Sprachregionen der Schweiz vertreten ist. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung zu beraten.

Was du bei uns tun wirst:

  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei ihren Abacus-Finanzprojekten, von der Konzeption über die Einführung bis hin zur Schulung.

  • Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich.

  • Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus.

  • Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting.

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet.

  • Du berätst und begleitest unsere Kunden vor Ort oder remote.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei.

Dein Profil:

  • Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und hast eine hohe Affinität zu IT und Digitalisierung.

  • Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden.

  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit der Einführung oder Nutzung eines ERP-Systems in einem KMU-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Abacus ist ein grosser Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du schätzt den Kundenkontakt und verstehst es, ihre Bedürfnisse in konkrete Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Du beherrschst Französisch und Deutsch und bewegst dich sicher in einem professionellen englischen Umfeld.

Was wir bieten:

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich bei Fidigit durch Experten im Bereich Finanzen und Abacus-Software weiterzubilden. Zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten in diesem Tätigkeitsbereich in der Schweiz.

jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description:
Stage Bouw

Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor!

Dit wordt jouw stage

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is!

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

Hier zit je goed!

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie.

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen.

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie.


Dit breng je mee

  • Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde);

  • Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij!

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

Meer weten?

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens.

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

Wie ben jij?

Wat ga je doen?

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
jobs.description:
Product Owner Werkplek & Support

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange (schaal 10) tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar (op basis van een 38-urige werkweek inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

 
De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:
•    je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;
•    13e maand;
•    variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;
•    arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;
•    26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;
•    goede studiekostenregeling;
•    prima pensioenvoorziening;
•    reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;
•    en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.


Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Senior Projectmanager

Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

Waarom CCS?

jobs.title: Senior Incident Response Consultant, Rapid Response
jobs.description:
Senior Incident Response Consultant, Rapid Response

Role Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service. The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant on the Sophos IR team, you will be responsible for spearheading incident response engagements for customers who have experienced a cybersecurity attack. In this role, you will lead a team of Incident Response Consultants, running customer-facing calls, providing detailed written updates via email, and determining the priorities of the investigation, delegating tasks accordingly to your team.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the appropriate actions have been taken by both your team and the customer to effectively neutralize the threat. Additionally, you will be tasked with conducting a thorough root cause analysis to determine the origin of the incident, including identifying whether any data exfiltration occurred, provided the necessary evidence is available.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.


What You Will Do

  • Lead kick off calls with customers to understand their situation and identify initial response actions to contain the threat

  • Provide guidance to customers on best practices following an incident

  • Lead daily update calls for customers to deliver forensic findings

  • Deliver concise email updates to customers between update calls

  • Direct the forensic investigations, identify priorities, and delegate tasks to analysts

  • Conduct multiple Rapid Response incidents concurrently

  • Determine TTPs identified by analysts and add them to the threat intel platform

  • Write clear and concise Executive Summary style reports in a timely manner

  • Responsible for basic to moderate complexity projects that contribute to the development of the Sophos Rapid Response service

  • Provide daily handover notes to teams located in different time zones, or when incident responsibility is being transferred to another Incident Lead

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations involving ransomware

  • Experience leading BEC investigations

  • Continuously learning and staying informed of the changing threat landscape

  • Proven track record of successful neutralization and remediation of ransomware threats

  • Excellent understanding of the Incident Response process

  • Excellent understanding of cyber risks and able to qualify them to customers

  • Excellent oral communication skills

  • Strong written communication skills

  • Ability to manage time effectively

  • Able to delegate and prioritize tasks across multiple incidents

  • Able to excel under stressful circumstances

  • Occasionally willing to begin work early and/or stay late when warranted for customer engagements

  • Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework

  • Enjoy mentoring and assisting in the development of junior analysts

  • A team-player attitude with a willingness to share knowledge

  • Ability to work some weekends and holidays

  • Post-secondary education in Cybersecurity, comparable

  • Cybersecurity certifications an asset (e.g. CISSP, GCFA, or similar)

  • Experience with SIEM technology (e.g. Splunk, ELK, etc.)

  • Willingness to work occasional overtime during peak times or holidays

  • Experience writing SQL queries

  • Experience writing PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripts

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.description:
Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Infrastructure & Security

About Quilter

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

  1. Curiosity

  2. Conviction

  3. Rigor

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Platform Engineer to build and operate secure cloud infrastructure and automate the controls we depend on.

Quilter uses AI to automate printed circuit board placement and routing. Our Platform team builds the infrastructure that runs these compute-intensive workloads and supports our cloud service and customer-managed deployments. You’ll own systems from design through operation and help shape a growing team’s technical direction.

Your primary focus will be cloud security, infrastructure maintenance, and control automation: access, secrets, vulnerability remediation, auditability, and repeatable evidence collection. You’ll own the engineering work behind those controls, partnering with business stakeholders on compliance scope and with Platform engineers on reliability, recovery, and efficiency improvements.

This role suits someone who enjoys designing durable systems and operating them: investigating problems, closing security gaps, automating recurring work, and verifying that the controls we rely on actually work.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain secure infrastructure. Improve cloud and Kubernetes configuration, network boundaries, machine identities, secrets management, least-privilege access, and audit logging.

  • Own the infrastructure maintenance lifecycle. Keep images, dependencies, and infrastructure components current; investigate vulnerability findings; prioritize remediation; and roll out changes safely.

  • Implement and automate compliance controls. Translate agreed requirements into technical controls, validation checks, access reviews, evidence collection, and remediation tooling. Work with business stakeholders on scope and audit support for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and prospective FedRAMP work.

  • Make recovery dependable. Work with service owners to implement and test backup/restore procedures, document recovery steps, and address gaps revealed by exercises and incidents.

  • Improve operational readiness. Partner with service owners on useful alerts, incident playbooks, and communication. Participate in production troubleshooting and follow through on corrective work.

  • Contribute to infrastructure efficiency. Help the team understand resource usage and cost, identify capacity constraints and waste, and make targeted improvements alongside security and maintenance priorities.

  • Partner on safe deployment and data access. Work with the engineers building our delivery, runtime, and data platforms to embed security and operational requirements into reusable systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience owning production cloud infrastructure, including the work of maintaining it, diagnosing failures, and making changes safely.

  • Hands-on experience implementing security controls such as IAM, secrets management, network restrictions, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, or secure configuration.

  • Practical Kubernetes, container, and infrastructure-as-code experience. AWS and Terraform are particularly relevant; comparable experience is welcome.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking, cloud services, and application behavior, with the judgment to choose a simple solution appropriate to the problem.

  • Ability to build and maintain tested automation and small tools in a language such as Python or Go, and to work effectively with software engineers on shared systems.

  • Ability to translate security requirements into technical controls and demonstrate that they work. You can explain implementation choices, validate behavior, and provide evidence for reviewers.

  • Interest in owning recurring operational work and improving how it gets done, alongside larger engineering projects.

  • Clear communication and prioritization: you can explain technical risks and tradeoffs, coordinate remediation across teams, and document decisions and procedures.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing technical controls or automating evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or a comparable program.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, customer-managed infrastructure, or restricted-network environments.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or cloud-native equivalents.

  • Experience with artifact signing, software provenance, or automated verification of software supply-chain controls.

  • Familiarity with GPU, ML, batch, or other compute-intensive workloads and their capacity/cost tradeoffs.

What Success Looks Like

Access and credential controls are documented and verifiable, infrastructure updates and vulnerability findings are addressed through a repeatable process, and required evidence can be produced without repeatedly reconstructing it by hand. Recovery procedures are tested with service owners, and incident follow-up leads to concrete improvements.

Business Development Managers (BDMs) play a critical role in creating early-stage pipeline and advancing opportunities within enterprise provider accounts. This role bridges marketing-generated demand (“MQL”) and sales-driven evaluations by owning the motions that move opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and later, as they ramp up, Discovery → Evaluation in partnership with AVPs.

The BDMs will engage in omnichannel lead generation—email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling—to activate cold or stalled accounts, warm target personas, and secure meaningful early conversations. They will partner closely with AVPs to tailor account-based programs for priority systems, execute targeted plays using solution-specific Sales Playbooks, and ensure exit criteria are met to progress opportunities.

This individual partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to gather discovery insights, build relationship maps, capture exit-criteria–aligned intel, and drive early traction that sets AVPs up for success.

This is a high-impact, visible role for someone who is persistent, operationally excellent, highly organized, and comfortable navigating complex provider organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Opportunity Advancement (Primary Focus)

  • Own the early-stage advancement of opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and as proficiency grows, Discovery → Evaluation.
  • Execute solution-specific Sales Playbooks to ensure all exit criteria are met before handoff.

The Senior Director, Pricing Operations will lead the transformation of Sophos's SecOps pricing function: building a centralized team, a disciplined operating cadence, and an AI-assisted governance model that let pricing move at the pace of the market. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace.

You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them.

You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts

Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

Opportunity:

Enterprise restaurant deployments are where voice AI meets the messiness of the real world: legacy systems, high transaction volumes, operational edge cases, and technology that has to work reliably during the busiest moments of the day.

In this role, you will embed with leading restaurant brands and technology partners to make those deployments successful. You will learn how their systems work, design the integration path, write code, troubleshoot production issues, and adapt Deepgram’s platform to the constraints of live restaurant operations. You will work directly with customer engineering teams and business leaders, owning the technical path from early discovery through go-live and optimization.

Your impact will extend beyond any single customer. You will identify patterns across deployments, translate field learnings into product improvements, and build the tools, reference architectures, and playbooks that help the team deploy faster and more reliably across large restaurant fleets.

This role is for an engineer who wants direct ownership of customer outcomes and enjoys turning complex, ambiguous deployments into repeatable systems. The goal is simple: make every Deepgram for Restaurants deployment feel effortless to the customer and deliver measurable value from day one.

Location:

This role is based in New York City or San Francisco, where many of our customers and partners are located. Being close to them helps us move quickly and stay connected to their needs.

This role also includes occasional travel to meet with customers, support sales engagements, and participate in key onsite interactions.

What You’ll Own:

  • Customer engineering partnership: Embed with customer engineering teams as a trusted technical peer. Lead technical discovery and solutioning for prospects and customers.

  • Technical integration and deployment: Own the end-to-end technical implementation of Deepgram’s voice AI platform for enterprise customers — from scoping and architecture through go-live and optimization.

  • Configuration and customization: Adapt and configure Deepgram’s platform to meet each customer’s unique operational requirements — menu structures, ordering flows, POS integrations, edge cases, and everything in between.

  • Production excellence: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues in live deployments. Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues when necessary.

  • Deployment infrastructure leadership: Codify patterns into tools, playbooks, reference architectures, and building blocks the broader team can use for other deployments and customers.

  • Feedback loop to product and engineering: Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable requirements for Deepgram’s product and engineering teams. You are the voice of the customer inside the building.

You’ll Love This Role If You:

  • You are hands-on. You write code, read logs, and ship fixes — you don’t just coordinate. When a customer has a technical problem, you roll up your sleeves and solve it.

  • You operate with extreme ownership and urgency. You treat every customer deployment as if your name is on the product.

  • You partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering, but you are just as comfortable on a customer’s Slack channel walking their team through an API integration.

It’s Important To Us That You Have:

  • Technical depth: You are an excellent software engineer. You are comfortable working across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, cloud infrastructure, and customer tech stacks. You use AI coding tools to move fast and multiply your output.

  • Customer obsession: Deep, personal commitment to your customers’ technical success. You take their problems home with you. You are not satisfied until the deployment is bulletproof.

  • High slope: Learns fast, adapts quickly, and stays effective in ambiguity without needing constant structure. You figure things out and move forward. You are excited to get your hands dirty solving gritty technical problems over sexy ones.

  • Communication and trust: Able to build deep credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders on the customer side. You are calm under pressure and relentlessly reliable.

It Would Be Great if You Had:

  • Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text, NLP, or conversational AI systems.

  • Previous early-stage startup or founder-led environment experience — you thrive in environments where you wear many hats and build from zero.

  • Previous experience embedded within a large enterprise customer’s product deployment.

Business Development Executive (South Australia and Tasmania, Dairy)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

As a Business Development Executive at Halter, you’ll drive growth across one of our most exciting combined territories: South Australia and Tasmania. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from finding new opportunities through to closing deals, and you’ll build lasting relationships with farmers as Halter’s on-the-ground representative.

This is a growth-focused role for someone who loves opening doors. You’ll spend most of your time in South Australia, where the largest opportunity sits, and around one week a month in Tasmania building on our established presence there. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support and other regional sales teams, sharing field insights to make sure Halter’s technology keeps meeting the needs of farmers.

Your work will directly support Halter’s mission to help 50% of the world’s habitable landmass become more productive and sustainable.

Location: Based in South Australia, ideally in Mount Gambier or Adelaide. Frequent travel within South Australia and regular travel to Tasmania (around one week per month) is required.

Who we’re looking for

  • Business development expertise: A strong track record in value-based sales, creating opportunities and closing deals. You’re energised by prospecting and building a pipeline from scratch, and you know how to turn new customers into long-term partners.

  • Agricultural industry experience: You understand dairy and beef operations and the challenges farmers face. If you don’t, you’re deeply passionate about the industry and willing to dive into the operations of a farm to learn fast.

  • Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. You make those around you better, thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

  • Territory management: You can manage a large, multi-state territory, using critical thinking to plan your time between South Australia and Tasmania and prioritise where you’ll have the most impact.

  • Problem solving and collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to tackle challenges and find solutions.

  • Willingness to travel: Comfortable with frequent regional travel, including regular trips to Tasmania.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting and expansion: Sourcing new leads through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events and other channels, as well as responding to inbound enquiries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation to close.

  • Hitting sales targets: Meeting ambitious growth targets by qualifying opportunities, demonstrating the product and negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Territory ownership: Taking real ownership of your territory, working with regional agricultural groups and building deep relationships across the dairy and beef industries in both states.

  • Customer onboarding and relationships: Making sure new customers have a smooth handoff from sale to onboarding and deployment, and staying close to them afterwards so they get the most value from Halter.

  • Field learnings and feedback: Being the main point of contact for customer feedback in your territory, sharing insights with Support, Product and Research and Development teams to drive product improvements.

  • Collaborating with Support: Partnering with the Support team to resolve customer issues quickly and escalating when needed, so every customer feels fully supported.

Our benefits

  • An inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind: we’ve partnered with Medibank Health Insurance to support your wellbeing.

  • An annual $1,000 self-development budget for anything that fuels your personal growth.

  • 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave, and other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave, because time to recharge matters.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Director of Research, Text-to-Speech
jobs.description:
Director of Research, Text-to-Speech

Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-First by Default

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

What You'll Do

  • Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.

  • Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.

  • Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.

  • Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains why models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.

  • Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.

  • Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.

  • Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.

  • Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.

You Must Have

  • Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.

  • Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.

  • A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.

  • Experience leading researchers and research engineers through other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.

  • AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.

  • The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.

It'd Be Great If You Had

  • TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.

  • Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.

  • Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.

  • Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.

  • Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.description:

About Cantina:

Cantina is a new social platform founded by Sean Parker with the most advanced AI character creator. Our bots are lifelike, social creatures that can interact wherever people are online—across voice, video, and text. Create yourself, imagine someone new, or choose from thousands of characters to share infinitely scalable, personalized content and seamless group chat.

If you’re excited about how AI can shape creativity and social interaction, come help us build what’s next.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for VC and adjacent tasks (controllable TTS, voice design and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • See research and engineering as two sides of the same coin and enjoy owning work end-to-end.

  • Are results-oriented, flexible, and willing to pick up whatever moves the needle.

  • Like collaborating closely with infra, data, and product to ship measurable improvements.

  • Enjoy designing experiments, listening tests, and metrics that correlate with user-perceived quality.

  • Eager to learn every-day, find and solve unique large-scale problems.

What You’ll Do:

  • Model Building: Architect, implement, pre-train, fine-tune, and post-train/alignment (e.g., GRPO/DPO) for large-scale speech models.

  • Experimental Design: Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of the models.

  • Tool Development: Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity.

  • Full-Stack Contribution: Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design.

  • Data Ownership: Define data requirements and collaborate on acquisition, curation, augmentation, labeling quality, and synthetic data strategies.

  • Rigorous Evaluation: Design automated objective/subjective evaluations—listening tests, SV/WER/ASR-based metrics, robustness & bias checks, and red-team studies.

  • Pipeline Delivery: Harden the training → evaluation → inference pipeline; profile latency, memory, and cost; and meet production SLAs with robust monitoring and rollback.

  • Safety & Responsibility: Contribute to safety/consent guardrails and to misuse/abuse mitigation for responsible speech technology.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Exceptional research/development experience with large-scale audio models (>8B parameters, >500k hours of data).

  • Deep hands-on experience with diffusion and/or flow-matching transformers, including practical knowledge of samplers, schedules, conditioning mechanisms, and distillation.

  • Deep hands-on experience training audio VAEs, neural audio codecs, and vocoders latent/tokenizer design, reconstruction and perceptual objectives, adversarial training.

  • Strong experience with multi-node, multi-GPU distributed training (FSDP/DeepSpeed or equivalent).

  • Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems.

  • Strong with PyTorch and performance work (profiling, CUDA/Triton/C++ as needed) and writing reliable production-quality code.

  • Shipped large-scale speech/audio or multimodal generative models to production.

  • Background in working with large-scale ML data, and the ability to iterate on data and triangulate quality using both subjective and objective signals.

  • Experience with voice cloning, speech control/steerability, or expressive speech generation.

  • Notable publications and/or open-source contributions in speech/audio/ML.

Compensation:

When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits for U.S.-based roles:

jobs.description:
Research Scientist, Real-Time Video Generation

About Cantina

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role

We’re working on real-time video generation for interactive characters, spanning realistic humans, stylized characters, and non-human identities. We want these characters to feel present: to speak, react, and express themselves through their face, gestures, and body language.

This brings together a set of closely connected research problems. A character needs a consistent appearance, expressive and coherent motion, and a natural relationship between speech and movement. The model also needs to respond quickly and keep generating reliably as an interaction unfolds. Quality, controllability, and efficiency all matter.

You’ll work across streaming generation, fine-tuning, distillation, inference optimization, and data. Some problems will call for a new training approach; others will come down to better examples, a more useful evaluation, or understanding a bottleneck in the implementation. Part of the job is figuring out which intervention is worth making.

You’ll have substantial freedom to propose directions, investigate unfamiliar ideas, and shape what we work on next. We’re looking for someone who enjoys that freedom and can turn it into a steady sequence of useful experiments.

What You’ll Work On

  • Real-time and streaming generation. Develop models that support responsive interaction while maintaining visual quality and consistency over time. Investigate latency, continuity, and how model behavior changes during longer generation.

  • Character expression and motion. Explore how appearance, facial expression, gesture, and body movement come together into a coherent character. Improve the relationship between speech and motion across different identities and visual styles.

  • Fine-tuning and post-training. Adapt video models to new data, behaviors, and capabilities. Investigate training objectives and conditioning methods, and follow promising ideas through implementation and evaluation.

  • Distillation and inference optimization. Make generation faster and more efficient. Work across model-level approaches and runtime improvements, measuring their effects on quality, latency, and memory.

  • Data development. Spend meaningful time with the actual training examples. Identify missing coverage and recurring failure modes, improve curation and sampling, and develop data that helps models learn the behavior we want.

  • Evaluation. Build comparisons that make progress visible and failures understandable. Combine quantitative measurements with careful inspection of generated video and the experience of interacting with the model.

  • Research and collaboration. Read relevant work, reproduce and adapt useful ideas, and share early experiments, demos, and findings. Help the team decide what deserves more time and compute.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience training or fine-tuning video or related generative models.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar methods quickly and turn ideas into useful experiments.

  • Good experimental judgment, ownership, and clear communication.

You’ll have freedom to explore new approaches. We expect fast iteration and early sharing of results.
